name: Fivestars
brief:
Product: Fivestars
One-liner: Customer loyalty and payments platform for small businesses.
Description: Fivestars is a leading payment and customer loyalty platform for small local businesses. Our mission is to help businesses and communities thrive by turning every transaction into a relationship. Since launching in 2011, Fivestars has become a rewarding platform with 60 million users discovering and driving sales to 14,000+ small businesses. We help drive over $3 billion in local sales per year.
Industry: B2B / Retail
Tags: Fintech, Marketplace
target:

name: AI-Powered Customer Service Automation Platform
brief:
Product: AI-Powered Customer Service Automation Platform
Description: Customer support AI agents that resolve queries across chat, email, WhatsApp, and voice with accuracy. Resolve complex queries through seamless AI and human collaboration.
target:
The AI customer support agent that knows when to stop guessing.

Automate support with AI agents that know when to answer, act, hand off, and stop.

Most AI agents fail quietly. Ours tells you before it happens.

Confidently wrong answers are what make support teams turn off automation. Every Kommunicate AI agent is built to recognize when it no longer has enough information to answer confidently.

Handles what it knows

High-confidence, high-volume questions get answered instantly, with the reasoning behind each answer visible to your team.

Hands off what it doesn't

Ambiguous, emotional or high-stakes conversations move to a human with full context. Nothing is repeated or lost in transfer.

Refuses to guess

Anything outside its training is declined outright. No invented policies, made-up order numbers or confident nonsense.

Results across Kommunicate customers

Support queries automated

Average across active customer accounts, last 90 days

Handoff success rate

Across all AI-to-human handoffs

Conte.it's AI agent now handles 9 out of 10 insurance queries before a human ever sees them

Policy purchases, renewals, and refund questions are now resolved automatically by Kommunicate's AI agents, trained on Conte.it's actual policies, not generic scripts. Conte.it's advisors only step in for the cases that genuinely need a licensed specialist.

OCCC gives students 24/7 answers and frees staff from the 2am email

OCCC's AI agents now handle real-time student, faculty, and staff questions around the clock, integrated directly with the campus LMS and SIS so answers are pulled from each student's actual records, not a generic FAQ. Staff step in only when a case needs a real person.

TelOne cut support workload 25% during outage season, when it mattered most

TelOne deployed Kommunicate's AI agents across web and WhatsApp to absorb billing questions, technical support, and service-outage updates, the ticket types that spike hardest when something breaks. Agents now handle the calls that actually need a human.

Lula lifted CSAT 40% without adding a single support hire

Lula's riders and partners now get instant, accurate answers from Kommunicate's AI customer support agents, the same agents that know when to resolve, when to escalate, and when to decline rather than guess. No new headcount, no dropped tickets during peak hours.

What to check before you sign anything

name: Tiriel AI
brief:
Product: Tiriel AI
One-liner: The AI workforce for freight dispatch
Description: Tiriel is the AI workforce for freight dispatch. Not dispatch software. A workforce: specialized AI agents, each with one job, one standard, and one boss, the dispatcher. Scout finds freight across 14+ load boards. Closer negotiates rates with brokers by phone, in parallel, within the rate floors you set. Coordinator manages your drivers in English, Spanish, or whatever language your fleet speaks. Auditor closes the paperwork, files detention and TONU claims, and processes PODs.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
Tags: Logistics, Supply Chain, Transportation, AI
target:
Don't buy dispatch software. Hire a dispatch team.

Tiriel is a workforce of AI agents with one job each. They scan your load boards, negotiate with brokers, coordinate drivers, and close the paperwork, 24/7, in any language.

Available across the United States.

One person. One phone. Fourteen hours.

You call. You wait on hold. You refresh five boards while a good load disappears from a sixth. You negotiate one broker at a time while three others move on. You chase a driver for a check call, chase a rate con for a missing field, chase the day until 9 PM.

Then tomorrow, you do it again, because every task in dispatch needs a human on the phone, and there is exactly one of you.

The ceiling isn't your skill. It's your hours.

Software waits for you. A workforce works for you.

Every dispatch tool ever built made the human faster at doing the work. Tiriel is the one that does the work. Specialized agents, each with one job, one standard, one boss: you. They talk to brokers while you sleep. They learn your lanes, your drivers, your rules. Every call they make teaches the next one.

You don't log in to work. You check in on your team.

What is an AI workforce for freight dispatch? →

Six specialists. One AI workforce.

Six specialists. One shared memory. What Closer learns about a broker, Scout uses on the next load. What Coordinator learns from a driver, Planner uses to plan the next one.

You direct. They execute.

Set the rules

Your lanes, your minimum rates, your drivers' preferences. The workforce operates inside limits you set, and never outside them.

Watch it work

Agents scan, call, negotiate, and file in parallel, 24/7. Every action lands in one feed, with a full audit trail.

Approve the exceptions

The 5% that needs human judgment comes to you as a decision, not a task. Everything else is already done.

Your workforce ran 11h 32m overnight.

This is Tiriel at 6:04 AM. Three exceptions need your judgment. Every agent action is logged to the minute. Everything else is already done.

Rebuilt one to one from the live product · design partner accounts anonymized

Real calls. Real rates.

Every call your agents make is recorded, transcribed, and logged. These two are from production.

Agent: Hello, I'm the dispatch assistant for Gallegos Dispatching. Is load 29641 from Birmingham, Alabama to Nashville, Tennessee still available?

Broker: Yes. We're at six hundred forty.

name: Vooma
brief:
Product: Vooma
One-liner: Automation platform for logistics
Description: Vooma is the AI agent for logistics. We help our customers automate manual tasks and focus on work that drives business value. Mike built self driving trucks as a founding engineer at Kodiak Robotics (prev. Uber, Otto) and led their motion planning and safety teams. Jesse grew a private equity backed logistics software company from $2M to $20M+ as CEO.
Industry: B2B / Supply Chain and Logistics
target:
Win and move more freight

AI agents for brokers and carriers to give teams superpowers

Trusted by industry leaders of all sizes

Your best people are drowning in the least valuable work

Reps burn out trying to stay on top of hundreds of calls, texts and emails

Brainpower is wasted copying, pasting, and chasing info between tools that don’t talk

Tribal knowledge is stuck in your teams' heads, which makes it hard to scale

Your most valuable data is locked up in emails and phone calls you can’t see

product

A complete platform to elevate your team from quote to cash

Comprehensive platform

Build your operations on a complete platform, not point solutions.

Complete operational visibility

Unlock the data in your team’s inbox and calls to drive better margins.

Collective intelligence, not tribal knowledge

A system that learns the nuances of your SOPs, customers, carriers and facilities.

Execute your best operating practices

AI workers that email, call, text and log into systems to get your tedious work done, every time, 24/7.

20 min

Faster response time

Improvement in email quote win rate

2+ hrs

Saved per day per rep

Inbound calls deflected

Reduction in data errors

Verticals

Unlocking your team’s potential to help you win and move more freight

Testimonials

What our customers say

"I've onboarded fifteen different tech providers over the last nine years, and this has been the smoothest, from the sales process through onboarding to continued support. Honestly, the best tech partner I've ever worked with."

“Vooma’s impact is evident across the board. Our team is happier because they don’t need to handle manual order entry, while our customers enjoy faster quoting.”

“Our reps used to spend hours buried in quoting emails. Now thanks to Vooma, they’re back to doing what they do best: talking to customers and winning more freight.”

"Vooma’s platform effectively integrates with our systems and allows our team and our customers to gain efficiency, without changing how we do business. We can offload rote tasks to stay focused on customer service and work that requires the human touch, so we can keep building meaningful relationships to drive our business forward."

“As sales grew rapidly, we found ourselves stretched thin between back-office work and providing an exceptional customer experience. With Vooma, we’re able to keep growing without getting bogged down in the manual details of freight logistics.”

name: Netter
brief:
Product: Netter
One-liner: AI native Palantir for mid market.
Description: Netter (YC P26) helps companies regain control over their data, so teams can pilot their activities with high precision. Most companies are sitting on years of valuable data, spread across different formats and disconnected tools that don't talk to each other. Netter brings technical capacity to companies that don't have an army of data engineers, and tackles their most complex data challenges. - A nursing home group was chasing unpaid invoices manually across disconnected tools.
Industry: B2B / Analytics
target:
Switch on your data.

Netter centralizes your scattered data to deploy analytics, workflows and ML models.

See Netter turn your scattered data into running systems. Live, in 30 minutes.

A nervous system to reconcile tools and teams.

Netter centralizes every source you already run on, cleans and enriches it into a living ontology, then lets your teams turn it into dashboards, workflows and apps through a chat, not a ticket.

Concrete use cases, deployed on Netter.

Already running in companies where data lives in too many places.

Market intelligence & sell-out

Sell-out, CRM and e-comm live in silos. Weekly reports always lag the shelf.

Dormant receivables

Billing and treasury don't talk. Millions sit unreconciled across sites.

Network control tower

POS, ERP, HR, reviews. Fragmented. Margin leaks compound before you see them.

Unify machine, maintenance and usage data. Predict component failure before it happens, schedule on evidence instead of fixed calendars.

Pull bookings from incoming emails, solve daily scheduling under delivery, weight and exam constraints, push the plan back into the existing planning tool.

Connect TMS, ERP and fleet data into a single operational model. Auto-optimize routes, load plans and costs so trucks stop running half-empty.

Tell us what you need. We build it for you.

Build with a conversation.

Describe the outcome. Netter shapes the data flow, picks the operators, and writes the code. You stay in the loop, you don't write it.

Connect anything.

120+ native sources: warehouses, SaaS APIs, files, webhooks.

Workflows that work for you.

Schedule, trigger, retry, alert. Every step versioned and auditable.

Drop down to code anytime.

Any step is a Python script you can read and edit. Fully dertiministic, no black box.

Observable, end-to-end.

Every step traced and logged. Filter, search, replay across every workflow.

Analytics in seconds, not sprints.

Versioned, queryable, embeddable. Every chart traces back to a single source of truth.

Secure by design.

Audit logs, role-based policies, end-to-end encrypted. Already used in high-security environments.

From raw data to running systems.

Plug your sources.

120+ connectors. OAuth, API or SQL. Incremental syncs and schema drift handled.

Map the ontology.

A living model of your business. One place, one truth.

Describe the outcome.

Tell Netter what you want. Review, tweak, deploy.

Ship and iterate.

Versioned, observable, secure. Owned by your team, day one.

The AI use cases reshaping your industry .

Get our report on the highest-impact AI use cases in your industry. Concrete data, real-world results, measured ROI.

Transform your company in 2 weeks .

brief:

Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Fintech, Payments, Telehealth, Digital Health, Health Insurance
target:
Hassle-free HMO plans for growing companies in the Philippines

Empower your team with hassle-free, tech-enabled HMO plans, tailor-made for small-medium enterprises (SMEs) and growing enterprises.

Experience the Hive Difference

Comprehensive & Modern Benefits

Complete HMO coverage with unique benefits such as teleconsults, mental health, maternity, and medicine.

Hassle-Free Care Availment

Responsive omni-channel customer care hotlines, members can request Letters of Authorization (LOAs), book teleconsults & APE directly from Hive portal.

Simplified and Efficient HR Processes

Add and terminate members with 1 day, see employees’ APE results, and request PMEs through the HR Dashboard.

Flexible Dependent Policy

Our dependent policy has streamlined hierarchy requirements, no minimum participation rate, and allows for cohabiting / same-sex partners.

MBL and ABL Plans

Choice of Maximum Benefit Limit (MBL) and Annual Benefit Limit (ABL) coverage for your team depending on company’s budget and preference.

Perfect for both SMEs and growing enterprises

Our comprehensive plans are accessible even to small teams, starting with a minimum of only 10 employees.

Add and terminate members with 1 day SLA, see employees’ APE results, and request PMEs through the HR Dashboard.

Inclusive Dependent Policy

Our dependent policy has minimal hierarchy requirements, no minimum participation rate, and allows for cohabiting / same-sex partners.

Perfect for SMEs

Our comprehensive plans are accessible even to small teams, starting with a minimum of only 3 employees.

We make sure your employees & their loved ones get the best care possible.

Inpatient, Outpatient, & Emergency Care

Comprehensive inpatient and outpatient coverage via LOA request at facility or Hive portal, including emergency care.

Pre-Existing Conditions

Medical procedures for members with pre-existing conditions are covered from Day 1.

Annual Physical Exams

Members can self-schedule at partner facilities such as Hi-Precision, Healthway, and many more, or HR teams may request on-site APEs at their convenience.

Dental Coverage

Comprehensive dental benefits including oral prophylaxis, temporomandibular joint (TMJ), and orthodontic consultations, fillings, x-rays, etc.

Medicine Reimbursement

Partial reimbursement for outpatient prescription medicine, processed within 10 business days.

Direct Teleconsults

Video consults with our in-house network of primary care and specialist doctors.

Mental Health Coverage

Mental health video consults with our in-house network of mental health physicians and psychiatrists.

Maternity Benefits

Cash assistance for normal delivery, C-section, and miscarriage for female members.

Wellness Initiatives

Quarterly Wellness Webinars on preventive care topics; Hive exclusive discounts at partner lifestyle, wellness, and fitness establishments.

Find the closest accredited providers with ease, ensuring prompt care is always within reach for your team.

brief:
Product: Relativity Space
One-liner: Building humanity’s multiplanetary future.
Description: Relativity is building humanity’s multiplanetary future. We invented a new approach to design, build, and fly our own rockets, starting with Terran 1 – the world’s first entirely 3D printed rocket, and Terran R, our next generation medium-heavy lift reusable launch vehicle. As a vertically integrated technology platform, Relativity is at the forefront of an inevitable shift toward software-defined manufacturing.
Industry: Industrials / Aviation and Space
Tags: Machine Learning, Space Exploration, Rocketry, 3D Printing, Manufacturing
target:
Launching a More Connected World

We build reusable rockets that make access to space more reliable and routine—empowering science, exploration, and innovation beyond our planet. Energized with new leadership and a bold mission, we’re launching forward with purpose and precision.

Whether it’s advancing scientific discovery or enabling new business opportunities, we’re building Terran R to open the cosmos to all who dare to explore.

We prototype early, test often, and iterate fast, turning complex challenges into scalable solutions.

Our approach streamlines production, reduces cost, and rapidly scales as market demand grows.

We are a team of engineers, technologists, and operators on a mission to better connect humanity to space.

Where Bold Ideas Begin

Innovation doesn't stop at rockets. From cutting-edge research labs, next-generation manufacturing, and interplanetary exploration, we're building the technologies that push boundaries far beyond launch.

Follow the Journey

name: Undermind
brief:
Product: Undermind
One-liner: An AI agent for scientific research
Description: At Undermind, we're building a search engine that can handle extremely complex questions. It’s geared at experts, like research scientists and doctors, who need to find very specific resources to solve high-stakes problems. We’ve rebuilt search from the ground up to address this. Our new approach employs high-quality LLMs to adaptively explore a database, mimicking how a human researcher carefully discovers information.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Machine Learning, Biotech, Search, AI
target:
Your AI co-researcher

Undermind finds the papers others miss, helping you start broad, go deep, and build real command of your field over time.

Trusted by scientists from thousands of research institutions

1000+ GSK scientists use Undermind

This tool Undermind has the greatest impact compared across all GenAI solutions in our scientific space.

Undermind accelerates the pace of our discovery of new medicines and positions our scientists to identify the most promising research directions.

Kim Branson

SVP and Global Head of AI/ML

Josh Ramette

CEO and Co-Founder

Describe your research. Undermind does the rest.

Explain what you're working on

Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.

Undermind searches the literature

It reads and evaluates hundreds of papers, follows citation trails until it's found everything.

Go deeper together

Iterate on reports, dive into full texts, extract details, and refine your understanding.

Stay in the loop

Undermind keeps tabs on your areas of interest and notifies you with important updates.

Undermind's v1 search engine delivered 10x better results than Google Scholar , and we've been improving ever since. Our v2 engine outperforms frontier agents with web search by a wide margin.

Dive deeper into the literature

Brainstorm research directions

Brainstorm with an AI expert that has read the relevant literature. Generate custom tables to support your research.

Verify responses

Trace any statement by following in-line citations back to the source paper

Gauge relevance

Quickly grasp if a paper is relevant to your unique question. Sort and filter however you like.

Stay up to date

Get notified whenever relevant papers are published.

More accuracy, less time

State-of-the-art literature search algorithms for complex research.

We evaluate paper retrieval on 23 complex queries submitted to Undermind, specified as natural language research goals. We sample randomly from non-sensitive anonymized queries, stratifying for diverse research fields. We filter out overly broad review queries.

We compare Undermind against frontier models running as search agents: GPT-5.6 in the Codex CLI harness and Claude Opus 5 in Claude Code. Each agent has web search and shell access, so it can reach public web APIs. Undermind runs the production deep search with an extended budget to trace the full ten-minute curve. A production search stops on its own after 2.9 minutes on average. Resubmitting a similar search continues from existing results, so users can reach the rest of the curve via multiple search submissions.

name: BillionToOne
brief:
Product: BillionToOne
One-liner: The genetic testing platform detecting and measuring disease.
Description: BillionToOne has developed a DNA molecular counter that increases the cell-free DNA diagnostics resolution by over 1,000 fold, which unlocks transformative improvements in prenatal screening and liquid biopsy for cancers. Unity Screen, BillionToOne's commercially available non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT), is the only NIPT that can assess fetal risk for both recessive conditions and aneuploidies from maternal blood.
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Diagnostics, Genomics
target:
More intelligent healthcare for all with single molecule diagnostics.

At the forefront of defining disease.

Our proprietary Quantitative Counting Templates (QCTs™) power our smNGS platform and our ability to directly measure sparse disease-causing DNA fragments, or molecules, at the single base-pair level. Several common and severe recessive conditions screened for prenatally are caused by single-base pair alterations.

Our technology enables quantifying these minute variations using cell-free DNA. We believe this quantification will open the door to exponential improvements in prenatal screening, liquid biopsy, and beyond.

Actionable insights from a single blood draw.

Unity Complete® is the first non-invasive prenatal test (NIPT) that uses cfDNA to assess fetal risk for recessive conditions and aneuploidy from a single maternal blood sample at 9+ weeks.

Northstar Select® and Northstar Response® are complementary pan-cancer liquid biopsy tests that guide therapy selection and enable treatment response monitoring in real-time.

Leading with passion and purpose.

Co-founders Oguzhan Atay, PhD, and David Tsao, PhD, and our team of scientists, engineers, and industry experts care deeply about every sample that comes into our lab.

Leading with passion and purpose

Co-founders Oguzhan Atay, PhD, and David Tsao, PhD, and our team of engineers, scientists, and industry experts care deeply about every sample that comes into our lab.

Coupling careers with great culture.

Extraordinary science. Extraordinary people. We work at the edge of science to transform healthcare. Whatever your craft, if you're driven to do extraordinary work and generous enough to help others do the same, we'd love to meet you.

Challenge the status quo that makes healthcare expensive, opaque and out of reach for most.

name: OpenMeter
brief:
Product: OpenMeter
One-liner: Usage Metering, AI & API Monetization
Description: OpenMeter's mission is to standardize metering with the goal of becoming the data source for AI and API monetization. We've built an open-source platform that processes billions of events into our usage lake in a matter of seconds, which acts as the backbone that serves revenue and efficiency teams.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
target:
Fastest Way to Ship Usage-Based Billing

Designed for developers, loved by product teams

Scalable Usage Metering

Real-time Metering And Usage Limits

Turn any events, logs, and metrics into revenue. Empower your customers to monitor their usage in real-time and control your costs through usage limits, notifications, and quotas. Our low latency limit enforcement also offers usage gating on the edge.

“ We use OpenMeter to do per-millisecond compute billing for the Trigger.dev cloud product. It flawlessly handles us sending a massive amount of events and syncing the metering data with Stripe. We use entitlements to restrict our free tier and use the API to power our usage dashboards. ”

Change Pricing, Break Nothing

OpenMeter is the easiest way to implement self-service usage-based billing and empower sales teams to provision custom deals. It has SDKs for popular programming languages like Node.js, Python, and Go and integrates with CRMs, tax and payment providers.

“ OpenMeter simplified our entire API billing process at Requestly. It automatically tracks how much each customer uses our API and creates Stripe invoices accordingly. What used to be complex manual work now runs smoothly in the background. It's exactly what we needed for usage-based pricing. ”

Launch Products Faster, Enable Deals

Flexible product catalog that supports your pricing and packaging. Makes pricing changes in minutes instead of hardcoding it through weeks of tedious developer work. Whether it’s plans, credits, usage-based pricing, or commitments, OpenMeter does it.

“ OpenMeter leverages event-streaming techniques from high-scale, battle-tested production systems at the largest companies. As a result you get realtime, reliable, and cost-effective usage-based metering out of the box. ”

Maximize NRR With Insights

Increase your revenue by acting on usage insights, such as expansion opportunities and identifying fast-growing customers. OpenMeter surfaces revenue opportunities for your sales team in their CRM.

“ OpenMeter provides a comprehensive view of your customers’ usage and revenue. You can see how much each customer is using your product and how much revenue they are generating. You can also see how much revenue you are losing to churn and how much you are spending on marketing. ”

Scalable Metering In 5 Minutes

Collectors For Your Stack

Meter your favorite AI tools, cloud infrastructure, frameworks, and more.

Build with OpenMeter

OpenMeter is the easiest way to implement self-service usage-based

Companies maximize their revenue with OpenMeter

Whether you're introducing new pricing, scaling your revenue operations, or consolidating your software stack, OpenMeter works for you.

name: Aravolta
brief:
Product: Aravolta
One-liner: Software to monitor, control, and optimize data centers.
Description: Aravolta provides a single pane of glass software for data centers to increase uptime, reduce costs, and improve performance. A single utility node onboards every asset within an hour and detects hardware failures, hotspots, and other issues. It also generates reports on important metrics like Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE), energy metering, resource utilization, and much more.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Enterprise Software, Cloud Computing, Monitoring
target:
Infrastructure, Building, and Power Software for Data Centers

Every building, electrical, and compute asset monitored, controlled, and available via API. One platform. Deployed in days.

Trusted by data center leaders

" We went from manual tracking to real-time branch circuit and tenant-level visibility in weeks, not months. "

" Aravolta was insanely fast and responsive. The team executed across three of our data center sites and gave us a true single pane of glass. For speed, visibility, and control. I can't recommend them more highly. "

" What used to take an engineer three hours now happens in minutes. That's real time back for our team. "

" What impressed us most about Aravolta was their urgency and execution... deployed same day... worked around the clock until the job was done. "

" Quick and efficient to bring online... unified building, electrical, and network management... flexible and customizable. "

" This was by far the easiest setup and the most impressive monitoring system I've encountered. These guys actually deliver. "

" Aravolta bridged the gap between our risk requirements and the technical reality of the data center, allowing for collateral auditing without creating operational friction for our infrastructure partners. "

Join industry leaders using Aravolta

One node to control every device in the building.

The Aravolta Node acts as a Virtual PLC to set up controls and automations across all building, electrical, and IT devices. Connect to any IT or OT device with no manual mapping or onboarding required.

Any IT or OT device

BMS, EPMS, DCIM, network gear, legacy serial, and modern APIs all on one node.

Zero manual mapping

Pre-built make/model templates with register maps, OIDs, scalars, and units already mapped.

Unlimited data points

We auto-pull every metric the device exposes. No per-point pricing, no metric cap.

48-hour onboarding SLA

Devices not yet in the library are mapped within 48 hours at no cost to the customer.

Bidirectional asset API

Read for monitoring, write for control workflows. All polling is read-only by default; control writes are gated, audited, and only enabled per device with explicit configuration. Every protocol runs out-of-band on the management network, so no traffic touches the production data plane.

Supported protocols, out-of-band

Building / Electrical

Modbus TCP, BACnet/IP, OPC UA, SNMP, and many more

Compute / White Space

Redfish, IPMI, iDRAC, iLO, vendor BMC APIs, and many more

name: Breez Labs
brief:
Product: Breez Labs
One-liner: Helping Companies Deploy Email Agents in High Trust Domains
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Artificial Intelligence
target:
Stop babysitting your ERP.

Breez is the ERP agent for Microsoft Dynamics 365 and NetSuite .

Client deposits, vendor payments, hotel commissions, and close-outs, end to end. read the case study →

Also deployed with operations teams in corporate travel and medical devices.

What customers run on it

Your best people are busy being the translation layer.

Your ERP can’t hold the way the business actually runs — so your team holds it in spreadsheets. The AR aging with collections notes and promise dates. The vendor master, maintained before anything gets keyed. The order log that lives between the inbox and NetSuite. Then someone types the spreadsheet back into the ERP, line by line, and does it again next month. Every hour spent being that translation layer is an hour of judgment you’re not getting.

Payment chasing

Open invoices chased from the ERP — reminders drafted on your templates, replies parsed, promises tracked, escalations queued for you. Invoices that quietly aged out get found.

Spreadsheets → NetSuite

Pipeline trackers and order sheets entered into the ERP as they change — every field cited to the cell it came from.

Documents → ERP

Contracts and invoices arriving in email and procurement portals get parsed, matched to the right record, and filed. Ambiguity goes to your queue, never a guess.

Vendor onboarding — Portal → ERP

New vendors from procurement portals verified, records created, banking details entered — flagged for approval before anything saves.

Sales orders — Inbox → ERP

Orders arriving by email become draft sales orders, matched to customer and price list, cited to the source email.

Three-way match

PO, receipt, and invoice matched before payment; mismatches and ambiguity go to your queue, never a guess.

Your ERP will never hold how the business actually runs.

That’s not a flaw in your ERP. A system of record has to be rigid — that’s what makes it trustworthy. But operations change every month, and the ERP can’t move that fast, so the gap gets filled by people and spreadsheets.

Breez is the layer in between. Procedures are typed playbooks, not code — change the procedure, edit the step, and the next run follows it. No ticket, no engineering cycle, no waiting on us.

The record underneath stays rigid and correct. The layer above it changes as fast as you do.

Encode the procedure once. It runs from then on.

name: Pivot Robotics
brief:
Product: Pivot Robotics
One-liner: AI for Robot Arms in Factories
Description: Pivot Robotics makes AI software for robotic arms that helps manufacturers automate their most labor intensive tasks. We are starting out with the dangerous task of metal grinding and are currently deploying our software on 10+ robots in a cast-iron foundry.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Industrial
target:
Intelligent Automation for Modern Factories

Precision processing and inspection that adapts to every part.

Why Pivot?

Manufacturing’s Finishing Bottleneck

The Labor Crisis

Skilled grinders are retiring. Training takes years. Manual finishing limits your throughput and introduces variability.

The Traditional Automation Pitfall

Fixed automation can't handle part variation. Programming takes longer than the parts themselves. You need flexibility, not just speed.

The Precision Demand

Part complexity is increasing. Tolerances are tightening. Your customers expect consistency that manual processes can't guarantee.

That's where our autonomous solutions come in.

What Can We Do For You?

Vision enables innovation.

Our vision stack drives both inspection and processing. The same perception system powers precise measurement and adaptive automation.

Part Processing

Adaptive automation finishes parts end-to-end. Grinding, cutting, sanding, machining, and spraying, managed by a camera-driven brain.

Part Inspection

Computer vision quantifies every part. Defect detection and gauging run on the same perception stack.

How Does Pivot Stack Up?

Proven in Production

5k+ Parts Per Week

Processing production volumes at major foundries across North America.

1mm Precision

Consistent tolerance achievement on cast iron components in demanding foundry environments.

<2 Year ROI

Fast return on investment based on labor savings and increased throughput.

100x Faster

Add a new part to the system without extensive programming or fixed toolpaths.

Where Can We Help?

Autonomous finishing that scales across industries.

Metalcasting & Foundries

Grinding and finishing cells already in production, delivering repeatable 1 mm tolerances on cast iron programs despite part-to-part variation.

Aerospace & Defense

Camera-first autonomy extends to aluminum, titanium, and composite structures with multi-axis finishing and traceable quality data.

Ready to Eliminate Your Finishing Bottleneck?

Whether you're processing hundreds of castings per week or exploring autonomous finishing for precision components, let's talk about what's possible.

name: Tempo: The blockchain for stablecoin payments
brief: Product: Tempo: The blockchain for stablecoin payments
target:
The blockchain for payments at scale

Tempo is a payments-first Layer 1 blockchain incubated by Stripe and Paradigm, purpose-built for stablecoin payments at scale. It gives businesses and developers a stablecoin-native settlement layer for global payments.

Purpose-built for stablecoins

Stablecoins enable instant, borderless, programmable transactions, but current blockchain infrastructure isn’t designed for them: existing systems are either fully general or trading-focused. Tempo is designed for payments at scale.

Shaped with global payment leaders

Incubated by Stripe and Paradigm, Tempo was designed with input from category-defining fintechs, banks, and commerce platforms serving billions worldwide.

Performant & scalable for any payments flow

Remittances

Send money across borders instantly, securely, and at a fraction of traditional costs.

Global payouts

Pay anyone, anywhere, in any currency—without banking delays or fees.

Payroll

Faster funding, cheaper cross-border payouts, and new revenue streams for payroll providers.

Embedded finance

Build compliant, programmable payments—in any stablecoin—directly into your products.

Microtransactions

Enable sub-cent stablecoin payments for pay-per-use services.

Agentic commerce

Facilitate low-cost, instant payments for agents to autonomously execute transactions.

Tokenized deposits

Move customer funds onchain for instant settlement and efficient interbank transfers.

Designed for real-world use cases at scale

Dedicated payment lanes

Guaranteed blockspace for payments at the protocol level. Fees stay low and stable even when network activity spikes.

Stablecoin-native gas

Pay fees in USD stablecoins. No volatile gas tokens, predictable costs, and simpler accounting.

Built-in stable asset DEX

Native DEX optimized for stablecoins and tokenized deposits. Low fees and maintained liquidity.

Payments metadata

Structured memo fields for invoices and identifiers. Reconcile payments against ERP systems without custom code.

Deterministic settlement

Blocks finalize in ~0.6 seconds with no re-orgs. Settlement certainty that matches existing financial systems.

Modern wallet signing

Programmable smart accounts with gas sponsorship, batch transactions, scheduled payments, and passkey auth.

Privacy

Opt-in privacy for balances and transfers, designed with regulated issuers. Confidential transactions with the auditability compliance requires.

Stay updated

Get Tempo updates delivered to your inbox. No spam, unsubscribe anytime.

brief:
Product: Emburse
One-liner: Expense management and AP automation.
Description: Emburse is an expense management platform that gives businesses more insight into and control over corporate expenses. Using Emburse, businesses may order virtual or physical MasterCard-network branded expense cards and assign these cards to employees or contractors for authorization of pre-approved business expenses.
Industry: Fintech / Banking and Exchange
Tags: Fintech
target:
Travel and expense management solutions

Emburse Expense Intelligence shapes what’s next

See tomorrow’s spend, today

Real-time spend visibility

Monitor spend across every channel to identify risks, policy drift, and opportunities as they happen.

Pre-submission intelligence

Improve accuracy with automatic categorization (39+ categories), global VAT reconciliation, and multi-currency support.

Proprietary finance-first AI

Purpose-built AI engineered for precision, security, and accuracy across modern finance workflows.

Global end-to-end T&E coverage

Manage Expense, Travel, AP, Cards, Invoice, and ACH Payments with localization for 100+ countries.

About Emburse Assurance

Finance teams move fast. Compliance needs to keep up.

Emburse Assurance adds an AI-powered compliance layer that guides employees in real time and helps finance teams prevent errors, fraud, and policy violations before they happen. By analyzing receipts before and after submission, it applies policies consistently, flags risk early, and supports global compliance requirements without slowing teams down.

The result is faster reviews, cleaner expense reports, and greater confidence across every step of the expense journey.

Manage spend with greater visibility, intelligence, and control

Emburse AI brings together travel, expense management, AP automation, payments, and spend insights in one connected platform built for visibility, compliance, and financial control.

Travel

Orchestrate travel and expense in real time with mobile-first tools that improve adoption, simplify compliance, and give organizations greater control over spend from booking to reimbursement.

Expense

AI-driven expense management captures, categorizes, and validates spend in real time to improve accuracy, strengthen compliance, and reduce manual work before reports are submitted.

Invoice & Payments

Automate accounts payable, invoice processing, and reimbursements with intelligent workflows, real-time visibility, and secure global payments.

Insights

Turn real-time spend data into actionable insights with AI-powered forecasting, risk detection, and analytics that help finance teams make smarter decisions faster.

What future-proofed customers are saying

The Emburse card program has really helped us because it reduced a lot of the backend processes, the manual touches of taking in checks for refunds.

Tim Dorren

Manager of Accounts Payable at Toyota

The ability to create reports as per request, per need, on ad hoc basis, or for very specific criteria without having to cleanse the report has been beyond immeasurable.

Amy Nah

Sr. Expense Specialist at Databricks

Emburse’s human approach to working with customers is what sets them apart. It’s that personal connection that helps build a long-term relationship.

Rob Potter

VP Finance at Slalom

name: Invitris
brief:
Product: Invitris
One-liner: Creating new protein-based drugs at scale
Description: Invitris radically simplifies how we create novel biological drugs. Our patent-pending technology platform turns DNA into synthetic proteins and was recently featured in the Science magazine. It makes creating new drugs >10,000x more efficient at <100x lower costs of material. Our killer application is enabling the newest generation of synthetic bacteriophages to combat antibiotic-resistant infections, which are threatening to cause more deaths than all cancers combined.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: Biotech, Nanotechnology, Drug discovery
target:
Building the manufacturing layer for AI medicine.

AI changed what can be imagined. Invitris changes what can be delivered.

Backed by

The science is ready. The factories are not.

AI can now design drugs faster than today's manufacturing infrastructure can produce them. We strive to mass-manufacture individualized drugs.

AI expands what can be designed.

AI has reached a stage where modeling proteins (antibodies, phages, vaccines, etc.) has become democratized. Designing fully de-novo proteins for individual targets is now possible.

Biomanufacturing was built for one-size-fits-all.

The infrastructure was designed for one drug at scale, not millions of variants at single-patient economics. This creates the new bottleneck: mass manufacturing. One-size-fits-all drugs are not the basis of a future where patients are treated algorithmically.

Invitris is the manufacturing layer.

From sequence to drug substance in four to eight hours, built for the economics of individual medicine.

Works where cells fail .

One machine. Any protein/drug. In hours.

Under GMP. Aseptic. End-to-end. For a wide range of protein classes.

Single-step process. Autonomous processing.

Built for the economics of individual medicine, not one-size-fits-all.

From digital sequence to physical molecule.

Gross margin at $1–2k COGS vs. $5–10k traditional.

More output than the leading technology.

Less endotoxin — cost-effective purification.

Three domains where today's manufacturing technologies fall short.

Pathogen-specific antimicrobials. Ready in days, not weeks.

Microbial evolution leads to the largest health-economic problem of our time: antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Tailoring antimicrobials such as bacteriophages is key to minimise resistance and maximise efficacy.

Platform for individualized manufacturing. Ready drugs for single patients.

Protein-based therapies, including antibodies, multispecifics, peptides, enzymes, and cytotoxic proteins. Perfectly designed to integrate into a therapeutic process enabled by AI modeling.

On-demand production.

We're building Invitris Pods — autonomous biomanufacturing machines for decentralised, on-demand production. No supply chain dependency. Countries produce what they need, where they need it.

A complete design test stack

From your design, at clinical pace.

Computational design coupled to high-throughput wet-lab validation.

The design-test loop closes in days, not quarters.

One platform, from first screen to GMP-relevant volumes.

Cell-free protein synthesis

Programmable reactions that turn DNA directly into functional proteins, antibodies, and phages — no fermentation, no host cells.

1,000 proteins per second

Microfluidic screening at a throughput that was simply not possible with conventional expression systems.

Sequence to structure

Computational design coupled to high-throughput wet-lab validation close the loop in days, not quarters.

Picoliter to liter

Seamless scale-up from screening droplets to GMP-relevant production volumes on a single platform.

The latest from the lab.

brief:
Product: AON3D
One-liner: Additive Manufacturing with advanced materials
Description: AON3D is a rapidly growing startup on a mission to put industrial 3D printing capabilities into the hands of those who need it most. Our technology has made it 10 times cheaper than before to 3D print with advanced thermoplastics, and we continue to push the boundaries on commercializing new materials for 3D printing.
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Hardware, 3D Printing, Manufacturing
target:
AI-Optimized Additive

Smart tools for manufacturing high performance parts, in any material, with the touch of a button.

300+ Clients Globally

Unlocked Materials. Unlocked Applications.

By printing end-use sensor housings for autonomous trucks, Locomation expedited product development while saving $50,000 – $100,000 and months per iteration.

In a mission to commercialize interplanetary payload deliveries, Astrobotic utilizes AON3D to manufacture high performance lunar lander components while reducing vehicle mass and saving time and money.

Pioneering the field of expandable space structures, Opterus leverages AON3D to print high temperature composite molds, saving $4000+ and 4-6 weeks per mold.

AON3D combines the affordability and flexibility of open material systems with the ease of use and repeatability of traditional closed ecosystems.

The AON3D Platform

AON3D’s physics-based thermal simulation software creates dynamic, part-specific print settings.

Paired with Hylo’s built-in hardware automation and in-process monitoring, the AON3D platform delivers repeatable, quality-verified parts up to 85% stronger .

Maximized Performance

Improved Throughput

Repeatable Results

Verified Quality

Hylo™

A production-ready 3D printer for manufacturing full-scale, end-use parts in high performance polymers, such as PEEK and ULTEM™.

Basis™

Software that delivers an easy, simplified AM workflow. Go from model to quality-verified parts with maximized properties in just a few clicks.

Open Materials

From cost-effective prototyping materials to aerospace-grade polymers, AON3D lets engineers print the materials they want, with the properties they need.

brief:

One-liner: AI-driven mobile cybersecurity
Description: Malloc monitors and prevents anyone from recoding or transmitting data from your mobile device without your knowledge. Malloc uses on-device AI to detect zero-click spyware and abnormal activity and blocks any suspicious communication in real time. We sell this to individuals, enterprises and governments that care about their privacy.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Privacy, Cybersecurity, Defense, AI
target:
PROTECT YOUR ONLINE PRIVACY & BLOCK SPYWARE WITH MALLOC

PROTECT YOUR ONLINE PRIVACY & BLOCK SPYWARE

In 2025, malware attacks have surged to over 8 billion globally, targeting millions of mobile devices daily. Malloc Privacy & Security VPN combines AI-driven spyware detection with a secure, no-log VPN to keep you safe and private online. Created with the mission to help people regain control of their digital lives, Malloc protects your data without compromising privacy.

Claim back your privacy with Malloc

Your privacy is important to you, but is it for your apps?

In this modern world, we rely on applications for about everything , but let's be honest: Can you really trust every app with your data? Is every app 100% free from tracking or spying and also 100% free from selling your data? Most of the apps we use every day gather data about us behind our backs and sell it to shady businesses. Now theres something you can do about it. Malloc can help you regain your privacy.

Spyware are on the rise

Access the internet safely and privately with Malloc

Ready to take control of your online privacy?

Download now to protect yourself.

Your Data Is Collected Every Day — Often Without You Knowing

Apps silently gather your personal data, location, and behavior. Spyware and trackers can monitor what you do and who you talk to — without consent. Malloc reveals and stops those hidden intrusions.

Secure Your Data with Malloc’s Advanced VPN & Spyware Protection

Malloc’s AI-powered VPN encrypts your internet traffic, shielding your data from hackers and trackers on public Wi-Fi and beyond. Our cutting-edge spyware detection identifies and blocks malicious software like Pegasus and Predator in real-time, ensuring your personal information stays private.

Stay Safe with Features You Can Trust

Detect Spyware

Get notified if spyware such as Pegasus NSO or Predator Cytrox are detected on your device.

Network Protection

Block connections to spyware, phishing sites, data trackers, advertisers, cryptomining, and adult sites using an on-device VPN.

Permission Manager

Check critical privacy permissions of your apps.

Apps Monitoring

See where the apps on your phone send data to.

Scan for Malicious Apps

Detect spyware, trackers, apps with risky permissions, or apps downloaded from untrusted sources.

Antitheft Alarm

Enable an antitheft alarm to protect your phone when charging in public places.

Camera & Mic Monitoring

Monitor when and which apps use your camera or microphone, and for how long.

Mute Mic

name: Retirement Planning Advisors
brief:
Product: Retirement Planning Advisors
Description: With effective retirement planning, we’re here to help make sure you reach your destination with confidence.
target:
A retirement roadmap for everyone.

Retirement is a journey. Take it with confidence.

People are talking

Get directions on the road to retirement

Journeys from the Past

Our Services

Five Pathways is here to simplify your retirement planning.

We’ll work with you to create a personalized strategy that incorporates all of the paths of retirement planning: Income , Taxes , Investments , healthcare , and Estate Planning .

Retirement Income Planning

Tax Planning

Your retirement plans may not include the IRS. But rest assured, the IRS has plans for your retirement. Let’s work together to make sure you get to keep the money you’ve earned. We’ll show you how to diversify your tax strategy and maximize your retirement benefits. We’ll make sure that paying taxes isn’t a roadblock on your way to retirement.

Investment Planning

The perfect retirement looks a little different for everybody. The ideal portfolio should be the exact same way. Let's make sure your investment outlook is right, while reducing risk, minimizing fees, and potentially creating a higher return. And because we’re fully independent, we only answer to you. Whatever your personal goals are, we’re here to keep your investments rolling in the right direction.

Medicare/LTC Planning

It’s not always easy to talk about aging. It can be even harder to plan for it. We’ll help you make a plan and build a retirement strategy that accounts for all contingencies. Make sure you’re ready for all the unexpected twists and turns on the path ahead.

Legacy/Estate Planning

You’ve worked hard for everything you have. We’re guessing you didn’t do it so you could leave your inheritance to your least favorite uncle–Uncle Sam. We’ll help you minimize taxes and reduce penalties. We’ll also show you those smart backroads that only the locals know about. And we’ll give you full control over who gets what. Make sure the people and causes you care about have the means to follow their own path.

We’ll work with you to create a personalized strategy that incorporates all of the paths of retirement planning by focusing on what is most important to you.

name: Swayable
brief:
Product: Swayable
One-liner: Swayable predicts consumer opinion and the impact of content
Description: Swayable partners with the world's leading brands and advocacy groups to change minds, behaviors and attitudes. We are hiring in data science, full stack engineering, data visualization, design, and operations. We welcome unsolicited CVs from anyone, and especially encourage women and people from under-represented groups to talk to us.
Industry: B2B / Marketing
Tags: Machine Learning
target:
Measuring the Impact of the World’s Most Important Messages

How Swayable Measures Impact

Real Science

Test content using rigorous randomized controlled trials (RCTs) on tens of thousands of verified human respondents, delivering the strongest possible evidence of its impact on consumer opinion and intent.

Rapid Insights

Get brand lift results in 24 hours, with customized impact metrics, emotional responses and qualitative feedback, as well as brand tracking and research surveys—all in one intuitive platform.

AI Native

Discover the ‘why’ and drive confident decision-making with instantly available, intelligent presentations and executive-ready end products. Learn more over time as the platform models and understands your audience.

The Swayable Platform

Creative Testing Learn More

Swayable’s high-powered RCT measurements prove how creative and messaging impact brand love, favorability, and purchase intent.

Brand Tracking Learn More

Track consumer opinion and brand equities over time, with customized segmentation to provide granular audience insights.

Research Surveys Learn More

Get a real-time pulse on consumer sentiment and opinions by polling respondents on brand perception or any other metrics.

Workflow Integration Learn More

Deploy systematic creative testing across the enterprise to ensure creative and media investments generate real business value.

Why New Balance Trusts Swayable to Validate Celebrity Ads

For New Balance’s “We Got Now” campaign, the brand needed to deploy creative content testing to uncover which celebrity ad spots would drive the highest increases in favorability, consideration, and positive feedback among this coveted demographic.

The Publicis-owned influencer marketing agency uses Swayable to routinely test content and generate insights into which creators and themes drive brand lift metrics. In turn, the company has developed an agile marketing framework for brands that it uses to make the most authentic match between brands and creators—and identify social trends to use in campaigns based on their relevance and longevity.

The Bimbo Bakeries USA (BBU) brand wanted to reach and convert younger consumers through digital and social marketing campaigns. Rather than relying on guesswork, the brand tested three message options for a brand refresh—and landed on a traditional tone that registered a 7%+ sales lift in markets where Swayable's recommended messaging went live.

name: Sleep Reset
brief:
Product: Sleep Reset
One-liner: One clinic for every sleep issue
Description: Our mission is to improve quality of life for millions of people by providing easy, immediate access to the world’s best sleep care. Sleep Reset is a modern, digital sleep clinic that delivers end-to-end care for every sleep issue — from insomnia to sleep apnea and beyond — all in one place. Available completely online, we make it simple to get evaluated, diagnosed, and treated without long wait times or in-person visits.
Industry: Healthcare / Healthcare Services
Tags: Mental Health Tech, Sleep Tech, Consumer Health Services, Health Tech, Digital Health
target:
A Full Sleep Clinic & Award-Winning CBT-Insomnia Based Program.

Sleep issues affect almost 1 in 2 people. And it's not about trying harder to sleep. We treat the root issues of your sleep so you can finally wake up refreshed. No referrals. No sleep labs. No waitlists. Everything you need to fix your sleep in one place. Skip the waiting rooms with simple, secure, online sleep care.

Over 3,800 reviews and #1 Rated Sleep Program

Featured in multiple well-known publications

It's clinically validated. For lifelong sleep health.

85 mins

2x

We accept over a hundred insurance plans in many states

Don't see your insurance? Reach out to help@thesleepreset.com to find out what your out-of-network costs might be.

More effective than sleeping pills

Sleep Reset is clinically-proven to increase your sleep duration by 1.5 hours, compared to Ambien’s 30 minute increase in sleep duration.

Sleep Reset

How Sleep Reset works

Sleep Reset doesn’t just track your sleep — it helps you fix it. Start with a free structured clinical assessment to understand what’s actually going on. Based on your diagnosis, we build a personalized care plan tailored to your sleep patterns and goals. From there, you’re matched with a dedicated sleep clinician or coach who guides you through the program, adjusts your plan as you improve, and keeps you accountable. Prefer to go at your own pace? You can also choose a fully self-guided program — no calls, no pressure.

Diagnosing your sleep issues

Order your home sleep device, sleep in your own bed, get results online. No insurance hassles, clear reports & interpretation by one of our Board-certified Sleep Medicine physicians. This is your all-in-one sleep health test from home.

Treating your insomnia

CBT-I is the gold standard for insomnia. Your dedicated sleep coach will guide you through our proprietary digital program based on CBT-I, helping you implement the plan with personalized coaching, actionable steps, and progress tracking.

Addressing your sleep apnea

Throughout the program, your clinician will ensure your oral appliance or CPAP is properly fitted and functioning, review your sleep test results, and make adjustments as needed to optimize your treatment.

Helping thousands fix their sleep

Hear from Sleep Reset members directly

The Sleep Reset Difference

name: Starling
brief:
Product: Starling
One-liner: AI enabling digital urine diagnostics in the home
Description: Starling is building a urine diagnostic remote patient monitoring platform that seamlessly integrates into anyone's bathroom routine. By detecting early changes in a patient's urine using our toilet indwelling mass spectroscopy device, our platform is aiming to prevent hospitalizations from numerous conditions like recurrent UTIs, BPH exacerbations, or diabetes.
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
Tags: Machine Learning, Medical Devices, Digital Health
target:
Daily at-home monitoring

At Starling Medical, we equip users with the tools and real-time insights needed to maintain healthy habits and access to care options.

Our technology is designed to empower users to take control of their health

Meet UrinDx™

An at-home device capable of monitoring aspects of your health every time you go to the bathroom

Partnered with Providers

Provide better preventative care without impacting your bottom line

Urology & Primary Care

Starling’s innovative program highlights patients' urinary health patterns and trends.

UrinDx real-time insights can motivate behavioral changes that may, along with a healthy lifestyle, lower the risk of rUTIs.

Starling supports daily rUTI patient exchanges, allowing you to focus on high-revenue and surgical cases.

Get reimbursed for providing preventative care and reduce repeat clinic visits.

AUA definition of rUTI: While there have been multiple definitions for a recurrent urinary tract infection (rUTI) in the past, the most recent guideline published and confirmed by the American Urological Association (AUA) in 2022 endorses the definition of a rUTI to be: “Two separate culture-proven episodes of acute bacterial cystitis and associated symptoms within six months or three episodes within one year” (AUA rUTI Guideline 2022).

Proactive care with our nurse-monitored dashboard and user-facing smartphone app

Promoting good antibiotic stewardship

With personal health insights delivered right to a patient's smartphone, they will have all the information needed to make healthier habits become second nature.

General FAQs

What is UrinDx™️?

UrinDx (ur-in-dex) is an at-home urine monitoring device that becomes a part of anyone’s bathroom routine. UrinDx sends your urinary health information every night to Starling's care team. If clinical concern exists, the team will reach out with next steps to schedule an appointment to understand the recent changes.

You can track your health insights, symptoms, upcoming telehealth appointments in the Starling App. All in one place!

What do I need to use UrinDx™️?

UrinDx is easily installed in the privacy of your home’s bathroom. You will need a smartphone with access to the internet and bluetooth capability.

Included in your shipment box will be the device, anchor(s), and a user manual.

Do I need special equipment to install UrinDx™️?

No special equipment needed! You will first download the Starling Medical app. This is how you will receive feedback from your urine samples and contact your Starling care team, if necessary.

name: Ionworks
brief:
Product: Ionworks
One-liner: Simulation software used by leading battery and automotive companies
Description: Every battery company spends tens of millions of dollars a year on experiments. Simulations that replace experiments reduce these costs but are currently underutilized in industry because they are hard to create and run. We make simulations accessible to every engineer, by helping them to create models from their own data, then run large scale simulations in the cloud to explore the full design space.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
target:
Better battery designs from the data you already have.

Battery simulation for R&D teams

Explore designs without building more cells.

Automate the work between cyclers.

Get more from every cell you've ever tested.

Built by the creators of PyBaMM.

Trusted by

Built by the team behind PyBaMM

Ionworks was founded by the creators and maintainers of PyBaMM, the open-source battery modeling package used across academic and industrial R&D.

Ionworks Studio brings that electrochemical depth into a web platform that turns your team's test data into validated models, design sweeps, and engineering decisions you can defend.

The problem with battery simulation today

Battery R&D teams need software that understands the structure of battery data, models, and experimental protocols. Not a generic simulation platform that promises speed and optimization in the abstract.

The challenge

Scattered cycling data

Results live across shared drives, email, and vendor-specific file formats. Nobody is sure which file is current or which cycler produced it.

What Ionworks does

One system of record

Every measurement is normalized, linked to its cell spec and experimental context, and searchable. Ionworks reads Maccor, Neware, Novonix, Arbin, BioLogic, and BasyTec natively. The data layer stands alone or feeds parameterization and simulation.

Parameterization bottlenecks

A DFN or SPMe model is only as useful as its parameters. Connecting data to model, fitting, and validating is manual and error-prone.

Parameterized models

A model, a validated parameter set, and a cell spec combined into one reusable object. The unit of work that makes simulations reproducible.

Slow build-test-iterate cycles

A fast-charge study can tie up cycler channels for weeks. Simulation answers the same question in minutes.

Protocol-driven simulations

Charge at 1C to 4.2V, rest 10 minutes, discharge at C/3. Simulation accepts the protocol formats your team already uses — saved, typed, or uploaded from a cycler file.

PyBaMM does not operationalize itself

Running a simulation in a notebook is straightforward. Turning it into a repeatable, traceable workflow across a mixed-skill team is a different problem entirely.

Reproducibility and coordination

When a colleague runs the same parameterized model against the same protocol, the result matches. Immutable models and simulation reuse remove the guesswork about inputs.

How Ionworks works

Measure

Your team's single source of truth for battery test data. Ingest files from all major cyclers — Maccor, Neware, Novonix, Arbin, BioLogic, BasyTec — into a normalized, searchable system. Every measurement stays linked to its cell, its protocol, and its experimental context. The manual work between cyclers — file conversion, protocol prep, metadata linking — runs automatically.

One system of record

Every measurement is normalized, linked to its cell spec and experimental context, and searchable. Ionworks reads Maccor, Neware, Novonix, Arbin, BioLogic, and BasyTec natively. The data layer stands alone or feeds parameterization and simulation.

Parameterization bottlenecks

A DFN or SPMe model is only as useful as its parameters. Connecting data to model, fitting, and validating is manual and error-prone.

Parameterized models

A model, a validated parameter set, and a cell spec combined into one reusable object. The unit of work that makes simulations reproducible.

Slow build-test-iterate cycles

A fast-charge study can tie up cycler channels for weeks. Simulation answers the same question in minutes.

Protocol-driven simulations

Charge at 1C to 4.2V, rest 10 minutes, discharge at C/3. Simulation accepts the protocol formats your team already uses — saved, typed, or uploaded from a cycler file.

PyBaMM does not operationalize itself

Running a simulation in a notebook is straightforward. Turning it into a repeatable, traceable workflow across a mixed-skill team is a different problem entirely.

Reproducibility and coordination

When a colleague runs the same parameterized model against the same protocol, the result matches. Immutable models and simulation reuse remove the guesswork about inputs.

How Ionworks works

Measure

Your team's single source of truth for battery test data. Ingest files from all major cyclers — Maccor, Neware, Novonix, Arbin, BioLogic, BasyTec — into a normalized, searchable system. Every measurement stays linked to its cell, its protocol, and its experimental context. The manual work between cyclers — file conversion, protocol prep, metadata linking — runs automatically.

brief:
Product: Adialante
One-liner: Cancer screening without barriers
Description: We know how to improve cancer outcomes by 8x-10x: you catch it early. MRI is the most robust and powerful cancer-detection tool in the world, yet systems cost millions to purchase, take months to install, and require high levels of technical skill to operate. We've redesigned MRI from the ground up with new physics, algorithms, and hardware, all to bring cancer screening to the entire world. Our mobile MRI is an imaging clinic on wheels. No equipment to buy, no infrastructure needed.
Industry: Healthcare / Diagnostics
target:
MRI delivered to your clinic.

Adialante brings a mobile imaging clinic on wheels to your practice — no machine to buy, no construction. Screen your patients on your schedule, billed per scan.

The full imaging stack, without the hospital.

MRI has been trapped in hospital basements for decades. Adialante redesigned it from the ground up so any clinic can offer diagnostic-grade imaging.

Mobile by design

An imaging clinic on wheels arrives at your practice — no shielded room, no construction, no capital purchase.

Pay per scan

A flat fee per scan. You collect the insurance reimbursement and keep the margin — imaging becomes a profit center.

On your schedule

Patients are scanned on site in hours, not referred out for months. The whole pathway stays under your roof.

Diagnostic-grade

Going vertical on the engineering solution lets us deliver a new level of image quality — quieter, lighter, and far more accessible.

Turning MRI from a reactive tool into a proactive one.

The problem

MRI is locked in hospital basements — massive machines, million-dollar price tags, weeks-long waits. Most clinics can't offer it, and disease goes undetected.

Our solution

A new class of MRI: diagnostic-grade imaging in a mobile unit that comes to your practice. No construction, no capital outlay — billed per scan.

An MRI at every clinic in the world.

One platform, every specialty.

Starting with prostate imaging today, expanding across the body as the platform scales.

Prostate

Pre-biopsy MRI for urology clinics.

Breast

Early cancer detection and screening.

Orthopedics

MSK imaging for sports medicine.

Brain

Neuroimaging and screening programs.

Whole body

Full-body imaging for comprehensive screening.

Kyle King

Nabil Othman

Be first to offer MRI in-house.

Description: Pyroscope is an open source continuous profiling platform. With just a few lines of code it will help you debug performance issues and find bottlenecks in your code.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, Open Source, Kubernetes
target:
Grafana Pyroscope

This page is also available in Markdown, which may be easier for automated readers and AI tools to parse than HTML. The Markdown version is available at https://grafana.com/docs/pyroscope/latest.md, or by sending Accept: text/markdown to https://grafana.com/docs/pyroscope/latest/. For broader documentation discovery, the curated index is available at https://grafana.com/llms.txt and the complete index is available at https://grafana.com/llms-full.txt.

Overview

Grafana Pyroscope is a multi-tenant, continuous profiling aggregation system, aligning its architectural design with Grafana Mimir, Grafana Loki, and Grafana Tempo. This integration enables a cohesive correlation of profiling data with existing metrics, logs, and traces.

Explore continuous profiling data to gain insights into application performance. You can query and analyze production data in a structured way. Use the Pyroscope UI or Grafana to visualize the data.

brief:
Product: Lucite
One-liner: Supercharging Insurance Brokers & Advisors
Description: Lucite is building the first AI-native platform to help insurance brokers and advisors automate the most complex and time consuming parts of their job. We ingest unstructured carrier documents to accurately extract and analyze data, create insights, and generate deliverables, saving firms hours of time each day.
Industry: B2B
target:
Turn carrier documents into client-ready insights.

Lucite is the leading AI platform for group benefits brokers & advisors. Elevate your client experience, win more business, and operate more efficiently.

Trusted by leading benefits advisors

This has changed the game for us. I can’t emphasize enough how much we love Lucite.

From document chaos to clarity, in seconds.

Upload carrier documents

Drop in any carrier document (PDFs, Excel, even screenshots). Lucite handles them all from every Canadian carrier.

Lucite extracts and analyzes

Lucite reads documents with logic tailored to Canadian group benefits and carrier-specific formats, extracting plan details, flagging changes, and surfacing insights.

Export client-ready deliverables

Instantly export fully customized templates, delivering polished, branded deliverables that set your firm apart.

Every stage of the client lifecycle.

A complete AI toolbox built for the Canadian group benefits workflow.

Marketing & Quoting

Compare quotes in a clean, side-by-side format for faster review and stronger client recommendations. Lucite standardizes data across carriers so you can spot the best fit instantly.

The operations behind great service.

Automate the tasks that slow your team down.

Commission Tracking

Analyzes compensation data to show what was paid by group and by advisor, with no more manual reconciliation across carrier statements.

Census Data Extraction

Pulls employee census data from source documents into structured, usable formats ready for quoting or renewal analysis.

Billing Statement Review

Extracts ASO, HSA, and fully insured billing data from carrier statements, generating clean rate tables when needed.

Group Retirement Analysis

Extracts and compares fund fees and rates of return to support GRS marketing analysis across providers.

Your client data, organized in one place.

Lucite becomes a central source of truth for your block, organizing key client data in an intelligent, structured, and secure system.

Built for firms that can't afford risks.

Enterprise-grade security with Canadian data residency and full regulatory compliance.

SOC 2 Type II Compliant

Enterprise-grade security audited and certified. Your data is encrypted at rest and in transit with industry-leading standards.

PIPEDA and HIPAA Compliant

Fully adheres to PIPEDA and HIPAA regulations. All data is securely stored within Canada. Your data is never used to train AI models.

You own your data. Period.

Lucite does not claim ownership of any data. Delete a document and it's permanently erased. Leave Lucite and we return your data within 30 days.

Canadian Data Storage

All data is securely stored within Canada, meeting the strictest data residency requirements for Canadian benefits firms.

name: Quilt Data
brief:
Product: Quilt Data
One-liner: Quilt manages data like code so that companies can experiment faster
Description: We realized that S3 is kind of like "git for data" and have created services that make S3 function as a data hub for teams. Quilt consists of a Python Client, a web catalog for browsing and visualizing S3, and a CloudFormation backend for compute and identity management.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Analytics
target:
Transform Data Chaos into Scientific Clarity

Companies that love quilt

Quilt helps life sciences teams organize, manage, and collaborate on the complex data powering their scientific work.

Quilt is an Advanced AWS Technology Partner

Quilt Data is an AWS Advanced Technology Partner. Quilt brings seamless collaboration to Amazon S3 by connecting people, pipelines, and machines using visual, verifiable, versioned data packages. Amazon Web Services provides secure, cost-effective, and scalable big data services that can help you build a Data Lake to collect, store, and analyze massive volumes of heterogeneous data.

Use-cases

Security & Compliance

Focus on discoveries, not data management

The Quilt Data Platform consolidates raw files, results, and metadata into versioned, searchable assets. Built for life sciences and deployed directly on AWS, Quilt creates a single, trusted data foundation that makes scientific information easier to find, share, and govern.

Unify Scientific Data Across Every Source

Establish a common foundation for collaboration across teams

Accelerate Scientific Work with Faster Data Access

Quickly find any data you need, directly in Quilt

Scale Data Management alongside Scaling Science

Optimize data governance with the power of Quilt and AWS

Why Quilt

Supports complex scientific workflows, handles large-scale data, and integrates with existing lab tools

The AI-powered Data Platform for Life Sciences

Flexible AI-powered search instantly surfaces structured and unstructured data

Advanced metadata tagging and indexing organizes information to improve search accuracy

Fine-grained access controls and audit logs ensure secure collaboration.

FAIR-compliant: Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable.

Packages are where AI in life sciences starts

A model is only as good as the data it can find and trust. A Quilt package bundles your data with its metadata and a versioned, cryptographic history. That gives models and agents the context they need, and lets you trace any result back to the exact data that produced it.

Packages you can verify

Data, metadata, and an immutable version history in one addressable unit. Every output traces back to an exact dataset, so it stays reproducible and audit-ready for regulated work.

Qurator: search in plain English

Ask for data the way you'd ask a colleague. Qurator searches your governed catalog and returns the right packages, scoped to what each person is allowed to see. No ontology expertise needed.

Bring your own model (MCP)

Connect Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible agent to your Quilt data with per-user OAuth. Models can read, visualize, and build on your data, and they only ever see what that user can.

name: LEAH Labs
brief:
Product: LEAH Labs
One-liner: Living therapies for pets first, and their people next
Description: LEAH Labs is building living therapies for pets first, and their people next. We're first focused on CAR-T cell therapy for dogs with B cell lymphoma, the naturally occurring clinical analog of human non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. CAR-T cells are curative in humans, and our early results are showing the same - we're inducing remissions in pets with late stage lymphomas.
Industry: Healthcare / Therapeutics
Tags: CRISPR, Cell Therapy, Drug discovery
target:
Fighting cancer at both ends of the leash

LifEngine Animal Health Laboratories

We engineer living immune cells to fight cancer in pet dogs — and our discoveries are already reshaping the future of human cancer therapy.

Designer cell therapies for pets first — and their people next.

When a pet gets sick, families face limited options. LEAH Labs is changing that. We combine world-class gene editing with novel protein engineering to revolutionize companion animal oncology — while generating the insights that will power the next generation of human CAR-T therapies.

Purpose built for pets. Advanced enough for humans.

Four pillars. One platform.

Generative Biology & De Novo Protein Engineering

Leveraging breakthroughs in AI and protein design, LEAH Labs designs, builds, and tests novel therapeutic assets that didn't evolve in nature. We're not iterating on legacy biology — we're inventing new biology from first principles.

Precision Gene Editing — GeneWeld

Our founder invented our gene editing platform during their PhD. This platform is a critical enabling technology that allows us to build CAR-T cell therapies at costs affordable to pet parents.

Harnessing Immune Cells to Fight Cancer

The immune system can detect and destroy cancer — but cancer evades it. Gene editing lets us reprogram T cells to become professional cancer-fighting assassins. CAR-T cell therapy is already curative in human blood cancers. We're bringing it their furry family members.

Canine Translational Oncology

Dogs develop the same spontaneous cancers as humans, in a shared environment, with a fully intact immune system. Disease in dogs mirrors disease in people. Every remission in a dog is a data point that accelerates human medicine — compressing timelines that would otherwise take a decade.

Clinical Trial

Our next clinical trial launches in May 2026

Our fully-funded clinical trial will be enrolling dogs diagnosed with B cell lymphoma. If you can travel to one of our three partner institutions, we want to hear from you. Treatment is provided at no cost to enrolled families.

University of Minnesota

College of Veterinary Medicine · Minneapolis, MN

Product: LEAH Labs
