Description: LEAH Labs is building living therapies for pets first, and their people next. We're first focused on CAR-T cell therapy for dogs with B cell lymphoma, the naturally occurring clinical analog of human non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. CAR-T cells are curative in humans, and our early results are showing the same - we're inducing remissions in pets with late stage lymphomas.
Industry: Healthcare / Therapeutics
Tags: CRISPR, Cell Therapy, Drug discovery

Fighting cancer at both ends of the leash

LifEngine Animal Health Laboratories

We engineer living immune cells to fight cancer in pet dogs — and our discoveries are already reshaping the future of human cancer therapy.

Designer cell therapies for pets first — and their people next.

When a pet gets sick, families face limited options. LEAH Labs is changing that. We combine world-class gene editing with novel protein engineering to revolutionize companion animal oncology — while generating the insights that will power the next generation of human CAR-T therapies.

Purpose built for pets. Advanced enough for humans.

Four pillars. One platform.

Generative Biology & De Novo Protein Engineering

Leveraging breakthroughs in AI and protein design, LEAH Labs designs, builds, and tests novel therapeutic assets that didn't evolve in nature. We're not iterating on legacy biology — we're inventing new biology from first principles.

Precision Gene Editing — GeneWeld

Our founder invented our gene editing platform during their PhD. This platform is a critical enabling technology that allows us to build CAR-T cell therapies at costs affordable to pet parents.

Harnessing Immune Cells to Fight Cancer

The immune system can detect and destroy cancer — but cancer evades it. Gene editing lets us reprogram T cells to become professional cancer-fighting assassins. CAR-T cell therapy is already curative in human blood cancers. We're bringing it their furry family members.

Canine Translational Oncology

Dogs develop the same spontaneous cancers as humans, in a shared environment, with a fully intact immune system. Disease in dogs mirrors disease in people. Every remission in a dog is a data point that accelerates human medicine — compressing timelines that would otherwise take a decade.

Our next clinical trial launches in May 2026

name: Eos AI
brief:
Product: Eos AI
One-liner: Autonomous OS for healthcare
Description: Eos helps clinics turn their data into actionable insights to identify more eligible patients and early care interventions. We harmonize historical data across all systems to create standardized patient data distributions, acting like a translation layer between different applications. Then we build a centralized index over it: a compressed representation that lets petabytes of raw data stay where it is while allowing us to search and reason across it as one system.
Industry: Healthcare
target:
Practice medicine, not administration.

AI operations for healthcare

Eos builds and runs operational and revenue-cycle workflows inside the systems your organization already uses.

From insurance and billing to referrals, scheduling, and patient follow-up, Eos adapts to how your team already works.

Healthcare data infrastructure

One infrastructure, fine-tuned for and by every deployment.

Eos makes customization scalable: every hospital gets a system built for them, and every deployment makes the next one better.

Your Eos

Work the way you already work.

Eos adapts across systems, workflows, specialties, and operating environments to fit your organization.

Harmonize healthcare data.

Eos is the predictive operating layer for healthcare practices. It unifies fragmented clinical and operational data, learns how each team runs, predicts where care and revenue-cycle workflows will break down, and executes the right intervention inside the systems they already use.

Unify silos

Reconstruct operational and clinical data across systems and time

Healthcare data lives in disconnected systems: EHRs, imaging archives, labs, scheduling, and billing, each using different identifiers and maintaining its own partial record.

Eos connects to these interfaces, resolves identities across sites and encounters, and links records into a continuous longitudinal history. The data itself stays in its original systems, but we can search and analyze distributed data as if it were one database.

Harmonize data

Make cases comparable

Clinical events are recorded differently across hospitals, scanners, and documentation styles. Without normalization, historical cases cannot be reliably compared.

Eos standardizes codes, imaging metadata, measurements, and documentation patterns into consistent patient trajectories, effectively acting as a translation layer between clinical applications.

VERA: Imaging Harmonization

Bring all modalities of medical imaging under a single standardized protocol.

LUCIA: Textual Harmonization

Structures EHRs from any system into a unified representation.

Models / agents in house

Your models and agents, running on your data

Eos hosts and runs your predictive models and operational agents in house, on top of the unified, harmonized record. You keep control of the models, the data stays in your environment, and inference happens where your systems already live.

Bring your own models, fine-tune on site-specific trajectories, or use Eos-built agents for eligibility, referrals, claims, and care coordination, all without shipping patient data to an external black box.

Predictive intelligence layer

From prediction to the full action

name: Velt
brief:
Product: Velt
One-liner: SDK for adding an agent and human governance layer to your product
Description: For most of software's history the hard part was making things. Writing the code, drafting the document, putting the report together. That is the part that is getting cheap. An agent can now produce in an afternoon what used to take a team a month. What doesn't get cheaper is verifying it. Someone still has to look at what the machine did, decide whether it's right, and answer for that decision later. Output goes up, review capacity doesn't, and that is where the work now piles up.
Industry: B2B / Productivity
Tags: Developer Tools, SaaS, Collaboration, Compliance, AI
target:
Add Review and Approvals to Your App

Velt brings governance to your product. AI and humans review together and work only ships once a human approves.

Comments · Approvals · Review agents · Memory · Audit trails

Proposed Pro price was $92, above the approved Q3 band. I suggest $85, the band maximum.

Your users need to review and approve what your product generates. Building that takes two quarters.

If your product has work that more than one of your users reviews or approves, this is for you. If it doesn't, it isn't.

Check all that apply.

Your users want agents that act. Nobody wants agents that act alone. The hard part is what happens between an agent's suggestion and a change to your users' data.

Let agents propose, not touch.

Every agent suggestion becomes a comment a human approves. On approval, the change is applied through your webhook, with a permanent record of who allowed what.

What is pre-bill review?

Syntra reviews every chart before submission, so billing teams stop chasing claims that have already gone out the door.

What financial impact has Syntra shown?

Anonymized 37-location ophthalmology group in New York, measured in 2025. Results below are from production use of Syntra pre-bill review.

Equivalent to ~1.5 additional providers in collections capacity, without adding headcount.

How does autonomous pre-bill review work?

Agentic pre-bill chart and claim review, then submission, with humans in the loop where it still matters.

Revenue Discovery

Capture missed coding opportunities across 100% of charts. Increase average payment per CPT code by $3-5 with autonomous pre-bill review.

Outpatient Coding

CPC-level review of CPT and ICD-10 before claims go out. Trained with real medical coders.

Compliance

Full chart and claim audit coverage with no increase in headcount cost.

Risk Adjust

Identify global period risk and adjust payments for risk-adjusted payment models.

We integrate with your EHR.

We plug into your existing EHR, PM, and related systems out of the box. If yours isn't supported yet, we'll assign a dedicated engineer to build a custom integration for your clinic.

Automatically logging into portals and downloading invoices 4. Navigating legacy content systems to do data extraction or data entry

Everything you need to take your business to the next level.

brief:
Product: Spark
One-liner: AI-powered workflows for energy infrastructure
Description: Spark AI is workflow software for solar, storage, and data center developers. We've reviewed and identified over 1 million zoning, permitting, and project-related documents in nearly every jurisdiction in America, so that you can instantly identify project requirements, local sentiment, and fatal flaws in seconds. We’re trusted by dozens of industry-leading developers representing over 90 gigawatts of project pipeline and $30 billion in financing.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Energy Storage, Solar Power, Climate, Energy, AI
target:
Permitting Intelligence for Energy Infrastructure & Data Centers

Agentic workflows for permitting, competitive intelligence, and community sentiment in seconds. Every county monitored, so nothing catches you off guard.

Trusted by Leading Energy Infrastructure & Data Center Developers

Metrics from leading energy developers on Spark

Trusted by leading energy infrastructure and data center developers

Deployment Intelligence Engine

Evaluate sites, navigate permitting requirements, track community sentiment, and monitor changes in real time

Selection

Assess prospective sites based on land use and past projects

Requirements

Extract permitting feasibility from zoning ordinances and moratoria

Interpretation

Derive community sentiment from local authorities, town hall meetings, and social media

Workflows

Accelerate portfolio and M&A diligence with automated analysis

End-to-End Site Screening, Diligence & Risk Analysis

From first screen to groundbreaking, and everything that changes after.

Planning & Zoning Reports

Every permit, every agency, every cost across federal, state, and local.

Document Diligence

Tired of "Ctrl+F" on hundreds of pages of complex policies and data rooms? Spark extracts answers instantly

Bulk Screening

Expedite screening by filtering through hundreds of markets and parcels at once

Monitoring & Alerts

Set an alert on any of 3,000+ U.S. counties. Get notified the moment zoning, moratoria, or sentiment changes near your site.

Developer Testimonials: Faster Decisions, Better Site Outcomes

How best-in-class developers accelerate their projects with Spark

Built by Experts in Energy Infrastructure & AI Software

Our team hails from top technology + energy companies and academic institutions

FAQ

How is Spark different from other siting tools?

Spark is not just site screening. It's permitting + zoning + local sentiment intelligence you use alongside GIS and mapping tools: Spark answers "can we actually get this built here?" with evidence-backed outputs (ordinance language, moratoria, process steps, red flags), not just a score.

Core differences:

ChatGPT is a general-purpose LLM optimized for drafting and summarizing. Spark is a domain-specific system engineered for deterministic coverage, verifiability, and scale—with persistent corpuses, citations, timestamps, and gap-reporting when something can't be found.

How fresh is the data (how often do you scrape/crawl)?

Spark crawls multiple times per week, continuously scanning authoritative public sources (AHJ sites, agendas/minutes, filings, local news) and storing each finding with a citation and timestamp.

Nationwide coverage across all 50 U.S. states, down to county and township levels (where online public-source presence exists).

name: Klaimee
brief:
Product: Klaimee
One-liner: Liability insurance for AI Agents. You deploy agents, we cover you.
Description: Klaimee is the first insurance for your AI agents. It covers what traditional E&O and cyber explicitly carve out, so you can deploy agentic AI at scale with real peace of mind. Built for companies deploying agentic AI, self-serve from day one. The problem: AI agents are taking actions autonomously buying, emailing, modifying sensitive data. AB 316 already holds deployers liable. EU AI Act enforces in August. Cyber and E&O insurance are excluding AI claims.
Industry: Fintech / Insurance
target:
Insure your agent. Get covered, fast.

Structured evaluation · Rapid turnaround

See Klaimee in action

Two kinds of harm. We cover both.

When an AI agent goes wrong, the damage lands in one of two places.

The agent harmed someone else

A customer, a partner, a member of the public. They bring a claim against you. Klaimee covers the liability and the cost of defending it.

The agent harmed you

It corrupted your records, made a bad internal transaction, or took down your own systems. There's no one to sue. The loss is yours, and Klaimee covers it.

The simple test: did the AI hurt a customer, or did it hurt you ?

What we insure: three real examples.

The kind of AI agent we cover, and what happens when it goes wrong.

AI voice agent for debt collection

A startup sells an AI voice agent that phones people to recover unpaid debts. On a call, the agent misstates a balance or breaks a collection rule.

AI customer-support agent

An AI support agent promises a customer a refund or a policy that doesn't exist. The customer relies on it and holds the company to it.

Internal AI operations agent

An enterprise runs an AI agent with write access to its own systems. The agent deletes production data or corrupts internal records.

Built for two kinds of company.

Whether you sell AI agents or run them inside your business, the exposure is real, and coverable.

Companies that build and sell AI agents

Enterprise procurement and legal won't sign off on an AI agent without proof of coverage. Klaimee gives them exactly what they're looking for: a certificate and a real counterparty for the risk, so your deal clears review instead of stalling.

Companies deploying AI agents in their own operations

When the agent damages your data, systems, or finances, Klaimee covers the loss. No third party required.

Where we focus today: B2B companies, bounded use cases, non-safety-critical. We don't insure autonomous vehicles, robotics, or physical-world safety systems.

Your AI agent isn't covered by the insurance you already have.

Most companies assume an existing policy has them covered. For autonomous AI agents, it doesn't.

Covers a hacker breaking into your systems. It does not cover your AI agent making a wrong decision on its own.

Covers a bug in software a human wrote. It does not cover the autonomous actions an AI agent takes.

name: Crosslayer Labs
brief:
Product: Crosslayer Labs
One-liner: Protect, monitor and defend your Internet presence
Description: Crosslayer Labs detects impersonation attacks on websites and APIs. We provide "outside-in" monitoring of customer infrastructure, comprehensively discovering and monitoring all Internet dependencies, including DNS, BGP, TLS certs, Javascript. We correlate signals from different layers of the Internet stack to identify attack patterns. Our alerts are actionable and contain root cause analysis/remediation recommendations.
Industry: B2B / Security
target:
Securing web infrastructure

Companies and enterprises across the world rely on the web for secure operations. We protect them from ongoing website and API hijacks.

Backed By

Trust the team that already secured 500 million+ HTTPS websites

The Crosslayer Labs founding team invented Multi-Perspective Issuance Corroboration which now secures the issuance of every HTTPS certificate .

Comprehensive Protection

We discover, analyze, and monitor all layers of network infrastructure on first and third-party services.

Advanced Threat Detection

We correlate signals across different layers of the network stack to neutralize threats.

Our Security Solutions

Our platform delivers the most critical security solutions all in one place.

Attack Surface Discovery

Understand the attack surface of APIs and web services to cyber attacks.

Security Analytics

Advanced threat intelligence and analytics to identify patterns and prevent attacks before they happen.

Ongoing Monitoring

Monitoring and correlating attack signals across layers for rapid response and mitigation.

Trust top network security research.

Our company was born out of a cutting edge network security research lab at Princeton University by some of the world experts in understanding threats to web services.

Meet Our Team

Our team of security experts brings decades of combined experience in network security, threat intelligence, and cybersecurity research.

Henry Birge-Lee

Founder & CEO

Computer security researcher at Princeton University whose standards and technology shaped the entire certificate authority industry.

Grace Cimaszewski

Founder & CTO

A graduate student at Princeton University who built global frameworks to understand the threat surface of millions of websites.

Dr. Prateek Mittal

Founder & Chief Scientist

Professor of Electrical and Computer Engineering at Princeton University specializing in network AI security.

Industries We Secure

A broad range of industries have exposure to web infrastructure attacks which can lead to billions in losses . Some of these industries include:

Healthcare

Healthcare depends on web services to securely deliver and protect data. Attacks on web infrastructure can lead to unauthorized data access, data loss, and ransomware.

Cryptocurrency

Cryptocurrencies companies are some of the most common victims of web infrastructure attacks leading to the largest unrecoverable losses.

Banking/Fintech

Modern fintech is has become increasingly reliant in HTTPS connections to users or automated financial systems. We protect this critical backbone.

Get Started

Ready to secure your network? Schedule a demo to learn more about our platform.

name: Momo Medical
brief:
Product: Momo Medical
One-liner: We help nurses in nursing homes to be 30% more effective
Description: We go to nursing homes, and we put an internet-connected bed sensor underneath all their beds. Our app gives nurses valuable insights and an overview of all their residents. We reduce fall incidents and bedsores while improving evening and night shift productivity by over 30%. Momo Medical solves the biggest problem affecting nursing homes, staff shortages while increasing the quality of care.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: SaaS, IoT, B2B
target:
A calmer workfIow for personalized care

What do caregivers see?

What is the Momo App?

Change the workflow to relieve workload

Current workflow

Doing rounds

Momo workflow

More personalized care for residents

The BedSense makes a substantial contribution to working more effectively. The enthusiasm in the workplace is enormous.

Results

Based on research in multiple skilled nursing facilities

Who is working with us?

For colleagues and residents

For the overnight shift

For residents

For nursing staff

For the clinical manager

Stories of caregivers

At one glance I can see my entire department and I see everyone lying in their bed, that gives me so much peace. That feeling cannot be described in words.

Residents are more active and less agitated during the day because they sleep better. One resident also started to eat by himself again, we no longer need to help him with that.

It has given me the peace of mind to stay longer with a terminal resident, while still having an overview of the other residents and knowing that they were okay.

We take the app onto the medicine cart in the morning. We'll see who's awake and then we'll go straight there. Then we don't have to wake up the residents for their medication.

Stories of families

Great job! What a wonderful asset in helping to keep our loved ones safe.

The document chase isn’t your job anymore.

DokuTrak collects your clients’ documents, follows up when they go quiet, and flags the wrong files. You make the final call.

The film illustrates a workflow with agents connected to DokuTrak. Delegate the mission: collect the documents for a client file. Here you go!

Thanks — this is 2022. I need 2024.

Just following up on this.

One request. A lot off your plate.

The checklist, the link, the follow-up, the first check. Together, from the moment you ask.

The request

No account. No password. Just the files.

Wrong type. Wrong year. Bad scan. Missing pages. Flagged before you start.

Your clients don’t need another place to log in.

Keep the software you run your firm on. Give your clients a simpler way to send the files.

name: Cova
brief:
Product: Cova
One-liner: Financial infrastructure for family caregiving
Description: Cova is an AI-native home care agency, licensed in Michigan. We serve Medicaid, LTCI, and private-pay patients; we pay caregivers the highest base rate in the state; and we help unpaid family caregivers get paid through programs they didn't know they qualified for. Our entire operation runs on AI agents, which means less overhead and more value passed directly to the people doing the real work.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Consumer Health Services, Healthcare, AI
target:
Covered Anywhere , Covered Always .

Home care from the people who love you, and the highest pay for the people who give it. Covered by Medicaid.

Choose your path

Two ways in, both covered by Medicaid. Pick the one that fits, and we'll take it from there.

Simple from the first step

Getting started takes minutes, and Cova does the heavy lifting from there.

Tell us about you

Pick your path — giving care or needing it — then share a few quick details. It takes minutes, and there is nothing to prepare beforehand.

We handle the paperwork

Eligibility, enrollment, Medicaid billing, timesheets. Cova does all of it, so nobody in the family has to become an expert on it.

Care begins

You keep caring for the person you were always going to care for — and start getting paid for it, on a schedule that fits your week.

Built so everyone comes out ahead

Most home care sends a stranger into the house and pays them as little as it can. Cova pays the person already there.

Thanks for giving me an opportunity just to focus on my mother.

I told my old agency I was moving to Cova, because I was proud of where I was going. I'm so happy!

I've been an unpaid caregiver for 18 years. I love this company! I'm happy to be here.

Nothing but professionalism and kindness. Always there for any questions asked. I've recommended Cova to families knowing they will be in great hands.

Your company, Cova, has done more in 2 days than the agency I was at did in a month!

Hover a face to hear from them.

Real words from Cova caregivers. Faces changed for privacy.

Family gets paid every week

The care a son, a sister, or a neighbor already gives is real work. Cova pays at the top of the rate for it.

Care stays at home

No stranger on a schedule and no move to a facility. Care comes from the person who was always going to give it.

Covered by Medicaid

If the person you care for has Medicaid, the care is paid for. Nothing comes out of the family's pocket.

Trained and supported

Ongoing training and a hands-on support team keep care consistent and standards high, at no extra cost.

We have answers

Everything you need to know before getting started.

name: Superlist — Task Management & To-Do List App for Work and Life
brief:
Product: Superlist — Task Management & To-Do List App for Work and Life
Description: From the creators of Wunderlist — the all-in-one task management app for to-do lists, notes, and projects. AI-powered productivity that replaces 5 apps. Free to start, works on Mac, Web, iOS & Android.
target:
Your work and your life, finally on the same list.

Flexible enough for project plans and meeting notes. Simple enough for groceries. One beautiful app for all of it.

Stop juggling five different apps. Superlist makes it simple to manage your entire life.

Plan your day

Schedule tasks, reminders and habits so you're ready for the day ahead.

Stay on top of work

Track projects, deadlines and meeting prep without getting overwhelmed.

Keep home in sync

Share grocery lists, chores and family reminders so nothing slips through the cracks.

Everyday superpowers. Superlist is light enough for daily routines but powerful enough for big plans.

Tasks + notes in one

Keep context where it belongs. Add notes or details directly to tasks so everything stays in one place.

Infinitely nested lists and subtasks

Break big goals into small steps. Organize projects with subtasks, layers, and checklists so you always know what's next.

Quick add from anywhere

Type or talk, jot down "Dentist Friday at 2pm" or say it with Talk, and Superlist makes sure you don't forget it.

Recurring tasks

Stay on top of habits and routines with reminders that repeat automatically, from daily workouts to monthly bills.

Widgets at a glance

Get ideas out of your head fast. Add tasks right from your home screen or lock screen without opening the app.

Coming from Todoist, Things, or TickTick?

The honest comparison:

Everything, in one place. Free forever to start.

Fair questions.

What does the free plan actually include?

Unlimited tasks and notes, 5 lists, sharing with up to 5 people, every platform. Free forever — not a trial.

Is there a Windows app?

Not yet — Windows users get the full web app at app.superlist.com. If a native app ships, it'll be in the changelog first.

Won't work and personal blur together?

Only if you want them to. The toggle hides any sphere — work, personal, your side project — with one switch, without moving anything.

Do the AI features read my private lists?

Only when you invoke them, and nothing is used for training. [Link plain-English privacy note.]

Start bringing balance back to your life.

Download for macOS

name: Benchmark
brief:
Product: Benchmark
One-liner: Decision infrastructure for investment firms
Description: Benchmark is the trusted AI platform for investment firms. Today, leading firms use Benchmark to screen deals, extract insights from unstructured data, and automate workflows. Our platform combines cutting-edge AI with deep industry expertise to help investment firms make smarter, faster decisions across their entire deal lifecycle.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Fintech, Finance, AI Assistant
target:
AI for Investment Firms.

Benchmark puts your knowledge to work. Move faster, make better decisions, and never start from scratch.

Your firm's edge lives in the thousands of deals you've seen, the memos you've written, the models you've built. But that knowledge is locked inside disconnected systems and the heads of people who've been there the longest. Benchmark makes all of it actionable, for your team and your agents.

Connect & structure your data

Your data is scattered across data rooms, email, models, and legal docs. Benchmark connects to all of it, extracts what matters, and structures it into institutional knowledge your whole team can query.

Put Benchmark to work

Screen deals, draft memos, build comps, monitor portfolios. Real deliverables in your format, grounded in your firm's full history.

Every decision makes it sharper

Every decision, outcome, and correction tailors Benchmark to how your firm thinks and how each person on your team works. Your newest analyst gets the accumulated judgment of the entire firm from day one.

How firms are using Benchmark

Reduced new deal screening time by 80% with all new deals screened by Benchmark. Surface relevant comps, flag patterns, and draft preliminary memos — before your team even opens a data room.

Feeds all existing structured and unstructured data into Benchmark, making it the core of their tech stack. Teams work end-to-end within Benchmark across the entire investment lifecycle — from sourcing through monitoring.

Uses Benchmark to generate investment memos and deal artifacts in minutes instead of days — dramatically reducing time to act on new opportunities as they hit the market.

Normalizes data across fund reports and performance metrics to build a unified view of performance — enabling them to cut through messy structures and noise.

Enterprise-grade by design.

Zero Training on Your Data

Your proprietary information is never used to train models. Your edge stays yours.

Enterprise Grade Encryption

Data encrypted in transit and at rest. Only authorized users access your workspace.

Enterprise Controls

SSO, audit logs, data lifecycle management, and granular permission controls.

SOC 2 Type II

Independently certified with regular third-party penetration testing.

Put your firm's knowledge to work.

name: Prometheus
brief:
Product: Prometheus
One-liner: We use solar and wind power to make zero net carbon electrofuels
Description: We remove CO2 and water from the air and use electricity from solar and wind power to turn them into zero net carbon electrofuels. These are gasoline, diesel, and jet fuels that work in existing cars, trucks and planes without requiring modification of their engines, and don't contribute to global warming because they don't add any new CO2 to the atmosphere. Each gallon of our electrofuels means a gallon of fossil oil left in the ground forever.
Industry: Industrials / Energy
Tags: Energy Storage, Climate
target:
REDEFINING THE FUTURE OF ENERGY .

Next Gen Energy Storage

Prometheus stores electricity as low cost clean diesel, jet fuel, and methanol through direct air capture and advanced electrochemistry.

About us

Prometheus fuels has developed a breakthrough new way to store electricity as fuels: synthesizing kerosene through direct air capture and a 100% electrochemical process.

Though this process can utilize any source of electricity: when utilizing low-cost, off grid solar, our zero-net-carbon fuels are competitive with commodity fossil fuel prices.

One process, limitless energy applications .

Applications

Data Center Power

Our Ultra Long Duration Energy Storage (ULDES) systems can shape and firm renewable energy seasonally, by storing it as liquid fuels when renewables are abundant, for months at a time, and using them when needed to provide firm, dispatchable power.

Transportation

Utilizing low cost off-grid solar energy, we can create carbon neutral fuels at prices competitive with commodity fossil fuel prices. This enables energy security, by ensuring the availability of fuels to power aviation, shipping, and anything else the economy needs.

Defense

Using power from a portable SMR, we can create diesel and jet fuel in a containerized system that can be transported by cargo aircraft. This enables the distributed creation of critical fuels in temporary or remote locations

On site or on grid

One technology platform, no infrastructure prerequisites.

From central grid infrastructure to the most remote operating environments.

On grid

Seasonal shaping and firming of renewables makes grids resilient. Our systems offer spinning reserves and inertia that high reliability requires, using conventional generators for peaking and baseload capability.

Off grid

Our ULDES and Fuel Forge systems are designed to operate with intermittent renewable energy and grid power is not required. They simply run when the sun shines and wind blows storing energy as liquid fuels, and they sit idle when power isn't available. This allows for remote electrification for any purpose.

Investors

BACKED BY THOSE SHAPING THE FUTURE .

name: Perceptron ML
brief:
Product: Perceptron ML
One-liner: We make law firms AI-native.
Description: We build AI systems for law firms, trained on each firm's own matters and deployed privately in their environment: timekeeping, intake and matter monitoring, research, discovery, and drafting. Our grounding engine verifies every fact against a primary source before a model can cite it, which is why firms trust us with work that off-the-shelf legal AI keeps getting wrong.
Industry: B2B
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Legal, Automation
target:
AI software built for your law firm .

We design and build bespoke AI systems for law firms, trained on your matters and deployed in your environment. Intake, discovery, drafting, and research, grounded in verified sources so the work holds up.

Legal AI that actually works. Because it is built around your firm, not sold off a shelf.

What we build

Software shaped to your practice.

Not another chatbot bolted onto your browser. We build custom systems around how your firm actually works. A few of the things we can build:

AI timekeeping

Capture billable hours automatically from your calendar, documents, and email. No more reconstructing your week from memory on Friday afternoon.

Client acquisition and monitoring

Watch dockets, filings, and news for the signals that matter to your practice. Standing alerts surface opportunities before competitors do.

Research that actually works

Grounded in primary law and your firm's own matter files, with citations you can open and check. Answers you can confidently put your name on.

Discovery and drafting

Review thousands of documents in hours instead of weeks, and draft motions and letters from your firm's own templates, in your firm's voice.

Why it holds up

Grounded, not guessing.

Every system we ship runs on our grounding engine. Every fact is derived from a primary source and checked before a model is allowed to use it, so answers arrive with citations, not confidence.

Expert testimony is admissible only where it rests on a reliable foundation and is relevant to the issues in dispute. Daubert v. Merrell Dow Pharms., Inc., 509 U.S. 579, 589 (1993) .

That gatekeeping duty is not limited to scientific evidence; it extends to technical and other specialized knowledge. Kumho Tire Co. v. Carmichael, 526 U.S. 137, 141 (1999) .

Exclusion is proper where the "analytical gap" between the data and the opinion offered is simply too great. Gen. Elec. Co. v. Joiner, 522 U.S. 136, 146 (1997) .

Citations verified

Daubert is a real case and supports the standard as stated 509 U.S. 579, 589 (1993), reporter checked

Kumho Tire extends gatekeeping to technical experts as cited 526 U.S. 137, 141 (1999), holding confirmed

Quoted "analytical gap" language appears in Joiner verbatim 522 U.S. 136, 146 (1997), quotation matched

Your matters never leave your control.

Client confidence is the product. We build for it from the first line of code, not as a checkbox at the end.

Deployed in your environment

brief:
Product: Nivara
One-liner: AI agents for the finance back office.
Description: We’re building AI agents for finance teams. They handle repetitive work across email and accounting systems - processing documents, following up on open items, reconciling records, and resolving exceptions while people retain approval and oversight.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: B2B, AI
target:
Get paid faster.

Nivara's agents chase your unpaid invoices, clear the approvals and portals holding them up, and bring you in when a person is needed. On top of the systems you already run.

Reads and writes the systems you already run

The cost of doing it by hand

Average B2B days sales outstanding

B2B invoices paid after terms

Industry benchmarks, not Nivara results.

What we do

Agents that close the loop

Not copilots, not chat. They read the systems of record, take the action, and write back what they did.

Built for why it's late

An approval that stalled, a portal rejection nobody saw, a missing PO number, an AP contact who left. Reminders on a schedule don't fix any of those.

We run it, not just ship it

You're buying the work done, not a license and a login. Our team stands behind the agents, and anything that carries risk waits for your approval.

Why now

This work wasn't automatable two years ago. It is now.

The documents finally parse

Remittance advices, POs, freight bills, emailed disputes. Reading a scanned packet and pulling the right five fields stopped being a research project.

Multi-step work holds together

The job was never one lookup. It's pull the record, find the source document, check the terms, decide, then write it back. Agents now carry that chain without losing the thread.

The economics inverted

Teams staffed up on this work because software couldn't do it. Those analysts are still the ones who know why an exception is an exception — they just shouldn't be the ones opening every document to find it.

Where we work

Each of these is a queue that grows every month and never gets smaller. We take one, prove it against your volume in four weeks, and earn the next.

Collections

We work the aging ledger account by account, follow up until it clears, and track every promise to pay. You set the tone and the escalation rules once.

Approvals & AP portals

The real reason enterprise invoices sit unpaid. We submit into Coupa, Ariba, and custom portals, fix rejections, and chase the person who actually releases payment.

Disputes & short-pays

Every payment that doesn't match cleanly is a dispute nobody has looked at. We pull the PO, the receipt, and the rate, then hand your analyst a decision.

Cash application

Match incoming payments to open invoices across bank files, emailed advices, and PDF scans. Post what's clean, queue what isn't.

One-liner: AI agents for the finance back office.
Description: We’re building AI agents for finance teams. They handle repetitive work across email and accounting systems - processing documents, following up on open items, reconciling records, and resolving exceptions while people retain approval and oversight.
Industry: B2B / Finance and Accounting
Tags: B2B, AI

Get paid faster.

Nivara's agents chase your unpaid invoices, clear the approvals and portals holding them up, and bring you in when a person is needed. On top of the systems you already run.

Reads and writes the systems you already run

The cost of doing it by hand

Average B2B days sales outstanding

B2B invoices paid after terms

Industry benchmarks, not Nivara results.

What we do

Agents that close the loop

Not copilots, not chat. They read the systems of record, take the action, and write back what they did.

Built for why it's late

An approval that stalled, a portal rejection nobody saw, a missing PO number, an AP contact who left. Reminders on a schedule don't fix any of those.

We run it, not just ship it

You're buying the work done, not a license and a login. Our team stands behind the agents, and anything that carries risk waits for your approval.

Why now

This work wasn't automatable two years ago. It is now.

The documents finally parse

Remittance advices, POs, freight bills, emailed disputes. Reading a scanned packet and pulling the right five fields stopped being a research project.

Multi-step work holds together

The job was never one lookup. It's pull the record, find the source document, check the terms, decide, then write it back. Agents now carry that chain without losing the thread.

The economics inverted

Teams staffed up on this work because software couldn't do it. Those analysts are still the ones who know why an exception is an exception — they just shouldn't be the ones opening every document to find it.

Where we work

Each of these is a queue that grows every month and never gets smaller. We take one, prove it against your volume in four weeks, and earn the next.

Collections

Approvals & AP portals

brief:

One-liner: Glide turns spreadsheets into beautiful, intelligent apps.
Description: Glide is a web-based app builder that allows non-programmers to quickly create powerful and beautiful internal business apps by starting from scratch, starting with a prompt, or starting with a spreadsheet. For 30 years, app development had barely changed. When Glide launched, we brought app development out of the Dark Ages, making it web-based, collaborative, accessible, and fun. Today, the influence of AI on coding has propelled app development even further.
Industry: B2B / Engineering, Product and Design
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Developer Tools, B2B, No-code, Enterprise Software
target:
Turn your spreadsheets into apps that run your business

Glide understands how you work, then builds connected apps for your team, your customers, and every part of your operation. No code required.

All your apps working together

A mobile app for your team in the field. A dashboard for your executives. A portal for your customers. Every app is connected to the same data, so your business stays in sync.

Everyone gets the right view. Give employees, managers, customers, and partners access to the information and actions that matter to them, without exposing everything else.

Your tools work together. Keep data, calculations, and workflows connected across your apps, without copying information between spreadsheets or rebuilding the same process twice.

Ask Glide

Ask your business anything. Glide understands the information behind your apps, so you can get answers and take action from one place.

Updates happen everywhere. Change a record, or update a status once, and every connected app reflects it automatically.

Start with something ready. Choose a ready-made app or create your own, then share it around the way your business works.

Glide grows with you. Start with the workflow your team needs today. Add new apps, users, or AI capabilities as your business changes.

From spreadsheet to apps you can trust

Upload any spreadsheet to GlideOS

Upload a spreadsheet or connect the tools your team already relies on. There is no need to start over or explain every detail from scratch.

Glide understands it

Glide reads the structure, data, relationships, and logic behind your spreadsheet, then helps create the screens and workflows your business needs.

Put it to work

Launch your app on desktop or mobile. Share it with your team, customers, or partners, and keep improving it as your business changes.

Apps in the office and in the field

Create polished apps for desktop and mobile. Every view stays connected to the same live data, wherever the work happens.

Connect the tools you already use every day

Bring in your spreadsheets, databases, and everyday business tools. Glide turns them into an interconnected OS for your business, without replacing everything.

Your business data stays in your business

Glide keeps your apps private by default, protects your data with encryption, and gives you control over who can see and change what.

Start with an app template, then make it yours

name: Astra
brief:
Product: Astra
Description: Astra is the vertically integrated payments platform designed for product teams and developers. Get started with a simple API integration and add unparalleled payments speed and security.
target:
Build instant payment experiences, not infrastructure.

Astra is the Payments Cloud: a vertically integrated, compliance-first platform that lets any company move money instantly across any payment rail. One integration, every use case.

Three ways to move money. One integration.

Your team integrates once. Every payment type after that is a setting you turn on, not a new build.

Push payouts to debit cards in seconds

Send funds to any US debit card over Visa Direct and Mastercard Move, with money available the moment it lands. Apply a transfer fee and payouts become a revenue line.

Fund accounts the moment users sign up

Pull money in instantly so the first deposit lands now, not in three to five business days. Activate users before the wait turns them into churn.

Run faster, lower-risk ACH

Same-day clearing and built-in screening on the rail you already use. Ship faster transfers and cut return risk without rebuilding a thing.

Gateways process transactions. Astra runs your money movement.

Processing is the small part. The real work is everything around it: KYC, AML, fraud, ledgering, reconciliation, disputes, and treasury. A gateway leaves all of it to you, and each piece becomes another vendor, another contract, another thing that can break. The cost shows up long before your first payment clears.

Astra does all of it, processing included, with one integration. Your team ships product instead of holding a payments stack together, and every new flow is a configuration, not another build.

Nothing to maintain

KYC, AML, ledgering, reconciliation, and fraud screening run as part of the platform. Your engineers move on to product work instead of holding the stack together.

Everything on one API

Every rail, plus compliance, controls, and treasury from the same foundation. With a gateway, each of those is a separate vendor you source and wire together yourself.

Live in weeks, not quarters

One API integration covers the building blocks a gateway would have you build from scratch, so a new use case is a setting, not a multi-month engineering cycle.

One Payments Cloud. Every part of money movement.

A gateway only includes one generic processing capability. A Payments Cloud natively supports many workflows, organized around a unified, integrated architecture’s single foundation. Hover over any layer or capability to see what it does.

Intelligent Routing

Picks the optimal rail and path for every transaction, tuning speed, cost, and success rate in real time rather than by static rules. Failover built in.

Cloud Services

name: Citus Data
brief:
Product: Citus Data
One-liner: Real-time. Big data. PostgreSQL
Description: The amount of time businesses spend on their databases is altogether too much time. Citus is fixing this problem. Citus is worry-free Postgres. Built to scale out, Citus is an extension to Postgres that is available as open source, as enterprise software that can be run on-prem or on any cloud, and as a fully-managed database as a service.
Industry: B2B / Infrastructure
Tags: Open Source, Big Data, Databases
target:
Citus 14 is here—with support for Postgres 18

Citus gives you the Postgres you love plus horizontal scale-out with schema-based and row-based sharding. 100% open source. Now with Postgres 18 support!

GET STARTED ABOUT CITUS 14

Scale Postgres by distributing data & queries. You can start with a single Citus node, then add nodes & rebalance shards when you need to grow.

Reduce your infrastructure headaches by using a single database for both your transactional and analytical workloads.

Download and use Citus open source for free. You can manage Citus yourself, embrace open source, and help us improve Citus via GitHub.

As a Postgres extension, it’s easy to keep Citus in sync with the latest Postgres releases & stay current with all its latest innovations.

Citus = Postgres At Any Scale

The Citus database gives you the superpower of distributed tables. Because Citus is an open source extension to Postgres, you can leverage the Postgres features, tooling, and ecosystem you love. And thanks to schema-based sharding you can onboard existing apps with minimal changes and support entirely new workloads like microservices. With Citus, you can scale from a single node to a distributed cluster, giving you all the greatness of Postgres—at any scale.

Applications That Love Citus

SaaS apps often have a natural dimension on which to distribute data across nodes—dimensions such as tenant, customer, or account_id. Which means SaaS apps have a data model that is a good fit for a distributed database like Citus: just shard by tenant_id—and for cases with no natural distribution key, you can use schema-based sharding.

ABOUT MULTI-TENANT APPS

Customer-facing real-time analytics dashboards need to deliver sub-second query responses to 1000s of concurrent users, while simultaneously ingesting fresh data and enabling users to query the fresh data in real time, too.

By scaling out Postgres across multiple nodes, Citus gives your analytics dashboards the compute, memory, and performance they need to process billions of events in real time.

ABOUT REAL-TIME ANALYTICS

Citus supports schema-based sharding, which allows distributing regular database schemas across many machines. This sharding methodology fits nicely with typical microservices architecture, where each microservice can have its own schema in a shared distributed database.

Schema-based sharding is an easier model to adopt, create a new schema and just set the search_path in your service and you’re ready to go.

ABOUT MICROSERVICES

Ready To Get Started With Citus?

With Citus, you can scale from a single node to a distributed cluster, giving you all the greatness of Postgres—at any scale.

Applications That Love Citus

SaaS apps often have a natural dimension on which to distribute data across nodes—dimensions such as tenant, customer, or account_id. Which means SaaS apps have a data model that is a good fit for a distributed database like Citus: just shard by tenant_id—and for cases with no natural distribution key, you can use schema-based sharding.

ABOUT MULTI-TENANT APPS

Customer-facing real-time analytics dashboards need to deliver sub-second query responses to 1000s of concurrent users, while simultaneously ingesting fresh data and enabling users to query the fresh data in real time, too.

By scaling out Postgres across multiple nodes, Citus gives your analytics dashboards the compute, memory, and performance they need to process billions of events in real time.

ABOUT REAL-TIME ANALYTICS

Citus supports schema-based sharding, which allows distributing regular database schemas across many machines. This sharding methodology fits nicely with typical microservices architecture, where each microservice can have its own schema in a shared distributed database.

Schema-based sharding is an easier model to adopt, create a new schema and just set the search_path in your service and you’re ready to go.

name: Agentic Fabriq
brief:
Product: Agentic Fabriq
One-liner: The control plane for AI agents.
Description: Agentic Fabriq helps companies securely manage what AI agents can access and do across business tools, data, and teams. We give each agent an identity, scoped permissions, approval flows, and audit logs, so employees and customer-facing workflows can use agents without relying on shared API keys, overbroad service accounts, or one-off integrations.
Industry: B2B / Security
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, B2B, Identity, Cybersecurity
target:
Agent identity, governed & secure.

The secure hub for agent identity, governance, and visibility. Control what your agents can access and do — for every user.

Where will your agent run?

Same hub, same controls — where it runs decides whose accounts it reaches.

Inside your company

Agents that act on behalf of your employees. Each person connects their own accounts, and the agent gets only what that person is allowed — every call logged.

Inside your product

Developer · self-serve

Agents that act on your customers' accounts. Each customer connects their own, and their credentials stay vaulted — your product never holds a token.

AI agents are starting to do powerful things

But your current tools can't handle this

The existing identity infrastructure was never designed for autonomous, non-human actors.

Every agent implementation reinvents the wheel. Teams waste months building proprietary authentication systems instead of shipping agent capabilities.

Without a unified identity layer, agents are treated as service accounts or raw tokens. You can't distinguish between different agents, their roles, or their permissions.

Agent actions are invisible. Security can't audit what agents accessed, who they acted on behalf of, or what went wrong when something breaks.

Impersonation logic is scattered across codebases. Teams can't reliably grant agents user-scoped permissions without major refactoring.

API keys, OAuth tokens, and secrets live in env files, vaults, and databases. Rotating them, revoking access, or tracing usage is a nightmare.

These aren't edge cases. They're blocking every AI-first company from moving fast.

Agents need their own control layer

Instead of agents directly connecting to every system, they route through Agentic Fabriq. We handle the auth, credentials, and governance.

One connection to hook up all your agent tools and data.

Define what agents can do — per agent and per user.

See every action, every user, every agent in real-time.

Every action checked against policy.

Fabriq evaluates each request — which agent, acting for which user, against which resource — and allows or blocks it in real time. No agent gets blanket access.

Connects with the tools your agents already use

Everything your agents need to run safely.

One platform. Every capability you need for secure, governed, observable AI agent deployments.

Agent & User Identity Management

Create and manage unique identities for every AI agent in your stack. Agents act on behalf of specific users while constrained to their permissions.

Fine-Grained Authorization & Policies

name: Genecis Bio
brief:
Product: Genecis Bio
One-liner: Makes guilt-free plastics from food waste
Industry: Industrials / Manufacturing and Robotics
Tags: Bioplastic, Synthetic Biology, Climate, ClimateTech
target:
Plastic, without the pollution .

At Genecis Bioindustries, we care about the beginning and the end.

We're a climate biotech company turning organic waste into sustainable, biodegradable materials, offering a circular economy solution for products’ beginning and end of life.

Product Offerings

Single-Use Plastics

Governments are rapidly banning single-use plastic packaging, including plastic bags. Genecis PHA plastic provides a responsible alternative to single-use plastic with the same properties as oil-based plastics.

Automotive & Textiles

Replacing harmful oil-based plastics with biodegradable PHAs presents an opportunity to differentiate your company as eco-friendly and environmentally conscious to your customers.

Genecis PHA is tunable: we can produce rigid and flexible PHAs to replace both automotive parts and softer textiles.

Packaging

Half of all plastic produced is designed to be used only once, resulting in an estimated 10 million tonnes of plastic ending up in the ocean each year.

By making the switch to Genecis PHA, your packaging can be composted or will naturally biodegrade, reducing environmental pollution without significantly increasing production costs.

Medical Tools & Products

PHA plastic can be used in the production of medical implants, sutures, cardiac valves, vascular grafts, and other medical equipment and packaging.

Because Genecis PHA plastic is produced from natural materials, it can be utilized safely in medical procedures.

We’re designing the future of plastics.

PHA is a safe and guilt-free alternative to traditional plastics. We engineer bioplastics that rival the performance of traditional plastics , offering a sustainable solution to plastic pollution. Our process is lower in cost and emissions than competing bioplastics producers because we use organic waste as a feedstock.

We work with businesses to de-risk their transition to sustainable products by helping them incorporate PHA and biomaterials into new product design, so they can make a difference without sacrificing quality or profitability .

Dream it — Polymer Development

We’ll develop and test the ideal polymer formulation for a current or new product line.

Genecis customizes PHA polymer composition to meet target biodegradability, functionality, and quality requirements for partners’ products.

Build it — Rapid Product Development

Let’s collaborate to develop new PHA-based products that align with your brand and sustainability goals. We'll work closely with you to ensure that the final product meets your specifications and is ready for commercialization.

Grow it — Co-Branding

Connect with consumers who care about sustainability and high-performance products.

Stand out with innovative products with enhanced functionality.

Increase sales and profitability while differentiating your products in a crowded marketplace.

Let's build sustainable products together.

brief:

Description: Scritch is building the leading AI systems for veterinary medicine, starting with voice agents that automate front-desk operations in veterinary practices.
Industry: Healthcare
Tags: Artificial Intelligence, Consumer Health Services, Health Tech, B2B, Healthcare
target:
AI Veterinary Receptionist

The all-in-one solution for client communication.

Everything a remote receptionist can do

Meet Emily, your AI receptionist

Fully customized to your veterinary practice.

Given Emily's ability to use our phone system and PIMS just as a human CSR would, it allows us to feel like we have another human team member on staff. She not only interacts with clients by completing tasks like scheduling appointments and emailing medical records, but also leaves us messages and tasks requiring follow-up like prescription requests. We treat Emily like any other team member and include her in our 360 reviews that we perform at 3 and 12 months of employment.

“ Since bringing Emily [Scritch’s AI receptionist] onto our CSR team, the number of calls that our human team needs to take has decreased by over 50%. ”

“ What used to be a solid 4‑star experience is now a joyful 5‑plus–star service that we are truly proud of. ”

“ The level of customer service that Claire and Rachel provide is truly exceptional. ”

“ Emily allows us to have more face time with the clients that come in. ”

Book a demo

Get started

If you're interested in booking a demo or learning more, please fill out the form below and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.

About Us

Scritch is a Y Combinator-backed startup based in San Francisco. As pet owners who have experienced the challenges of navigating veterinary care for their 19-year-old and 14-year-old dogs, Claire Lee and Rachel Lee founded Scritch to improve the client experience and ease the load on veterinary teams. Claire and Rachel are sisters and Princeton and Cornell alums who built safety-critical AI & software at Tesla and Amazon. Today, they’re building the leading AI agents for veterinary medicine - solutions that genuinely serve the needs of practices and their clients.

As the pet-owning population grows, veterinary professionals are under more pressure than ever — facing high burnout rates, emotionally demanding work, and limited time to meet rising expectations. We’re building AI coworkers to support and augment this workforce — lightening their load, improving the client experience, and helping more pets get the care they need.

name: Capveon
brief:
Product: Capveon
One-liner: Turning infrastructure demand into action
Industry: Government
Tags: GovTech
target:
Operationalizing American infrastructure.

The operating layer for infrastructure

Capveon holds everything your business knows in one model: the feeds you buy, the systems you run, the machines in the field. It automates the work between them, from the funding action to the defect code, and the gain shows up in margin.

The premise

Your operation is fully instrumented. None of it is operating.

Your business already records almost everything it needs to decide anything. It sits in a dozen tools that can each answer a question and none of which can act on the answer, so the judgement that connects them lives in three or four people's heads. That is key-person risk, and it is priced into every bid you lose and every renewal you defer.

How it works

Everything reads in. One gate writes out.

Purchased feeds, the systems you already run, and the machines in the field all enter as the same kind of fact. Everything that leaves passes a person first: an opportunity in your CRM, a priced scope, a work order.

Purchased feeds

Dodge · ConstructConnect · GovWin · Citylitics · SAM.gov

Systems of record

Salesforce · HubSpot · your ERP · project files · every bid won or lost

Robotics and field telemetry

The public record

One governed model

Ontology

Assets, contracts, crews and documents, typed and linked

Agents

Named readers with a fixed grant. Every claim cites its document

Automation

Versioned workflows, with a trace per run

Approval queue

A person on every irreversible write

Your CRM

An opportunity, with the exact field changes spelled out

A priced scope

Routed to whoever can authorize the work

A work order

On the asset that produced the finding, in your CMMS

The monthly your CFO reads. The API your team queries

Where it runs

Built for the people who own the asset.

Two kinds of buyer: the people who own the asset, and the people who sell into it — including the distributors in between. The model changes shape by industry. The machine does not.

Owners and operators

Telemetry from the pumps, the survey flights, the work orders, the permits and the as-builts, held as one model. The renewal plan and the procurement packet get drafted out of it.

Public works and DOT

name: Ångström AI
brief:
Product: Ångström AI
One-liner: Gen AI molecular simulations that reproduce wetlab results
Description: Angstrom AI builds GenAI-based molecular simulations to substitute wet lab experiments in the pre-clinical drug development pipeline. We are a team of 2 PhD's and 2 Professors from the University of Cambridge who decided to start a company together after we realised how to combine breakthoughs in our research in quantum-accurate models of physics and generative AI models.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
Tags: AI-powered Drug Discovery, Artificial Intelligence, Biotech, Drug discovery, AI
target:
Replacing Lab Experiments with Computation

Fast, accurate AI physics simulations for pharma. Compute solubility, lipophilicity, crystal structure stability and more with accuracy matching experimental error.

Team

Laurence Midgley

Cofounder, CEO

Miguel Hernández-Lobato

Cofounder, Head of AI

Gábor Csányi

Cofounder, Head of Science

Bálint Máté

Member of Technical Staff

Graeme Day

Our Science

DFT Accuracy on Crystal Structure Prediction with Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials

LI Midgley, C Lin, JH Moore, F Della Pia, J Antorán, SO Nilsson Lill, ESE Eriksson, FA Faber, L Tornberg, A Broo, G Csányi

We present an evaluation of CSP-MACE-Å, a machine learning interatomic potential intended to replace DFT in crystal structure prediction (CSP). By running multiple orders of magnitude faster than DFT, CSP-MACE-Å enables energy and free energy evaluation of far more candidate structures, providing greater confidence when derisking solid forms.

Computing Solvation Free Energies of Small Molecules with Experimental Accuracy

JH Moore, DJ Cole, G Csányi

We introduce an efficient alchemical free energy protocol that enables calculations of rigorous free energy differences in condensed phase systems modeled entirely by MLPs. Using a pretrained, transferable, alchemically equipped MLP model, we demonstrate subchemical accuracy for the solvation free energies of a wide range of organic molecules.

Flow Annealed Importance Sampling Bootstrap

LI Midgley, V Stimper, GNC Simm, B Schölkopf, JM Hernández-Lobato

We introduce FAB, a new method for training generative models to sample accurately from Boltzmann distributions of molecular systems using only the energy function, without requiring samples from the target distribution. We are the first to learn the Boltzmann distribution of the alanine dipeptide molecule using only the unnormalized target density, without access to samples generated via Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations.

SE(3) Equivariant Augmented Coupling Flows

LI Midgley, V Stimper, J Antorán, E Mathieu, B Schölkopf, JM Hernández-Lobato

We present a coupling normalizing flow architecture that preserves SE(3) and permutation equivariance while providing both fast sampling and density evaluation. We are the first to learn the full Boltzmann distribution of alanine dipeptide by only modeling the Cartesian positions of its atoms.

Reach out to us

Interested in seeing what Ångström AI can do for your drug discovery pipeline? We'd love to show you a demo.

name: Strand AI
brief:
Product: Strand AI
One-liner: Multimodal foundation models to predict uncollected patient biology
Description: Strand AI develops foundation models to generate missing bio-data about patients. With this imputed data, pharmaceutical companies can select better patients for their drug trials and shave months from their drug launch timelines. We’ve already trained a multimodal foundation model that integrates spatial biology modalities, beating SOTA at a fraction of the cost.
Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery
target:
Spatial proteomics from H&E

Lattice predicts spatially resolved protein-marker maps from routine H&E, delivered as virtual mIF channels. It is the first model in our missing data layer for biology.

Spatial proteomics from a slide you already have.

Each model output is a virtual multiplex immunofluorescence channel predicted at the resolution of the underlying image. Pan-cancer and pan-tissue.

No extra tissue

The prediction is computational. Precious archival blocks stay intact and go straight back on the shelf.

Whole cohorts

Runs across an entire archive, not a handful of chosen sections, so retrospective studies become viable again.

Pan-cancer

Trained across a broad span of tumour and tissue types rather than a single indication and a fixed marker panel.

Validated at every scale.

Lattice was developed on thousands of tissue regions and millions of image patches, drawn overwhelmingly from cancer tissue and spanning more than a hundred protein markers. Pan-cancer and pan-tissue by construction, rather than tuned to one indication and a fixed panel.

Pixel

Predicted intensity against the real stain, pixel for pixel, on tissue the model never saw during training.

Cell

Cells segmented and typed from the prediction, then matched against the same cells typed from real multiplex.

Region

Marker composition and tissue organisation across a whole slide or tissue core.

Population

Predicted phenotypes carried across entire cohorts into stratification and survival analysis, where the readout is a population-level outcome.

Send slides. Get answers back.

We run this end to end as a dry lab. There is nothing for your team to install, validate, or staff.

You send H&E

Industry: Healthcare / Drug Discovery and Delivery

Spatial proteomics from H&E

Lattice predicts spatially resolved protein-marker maps from routine H&E, delivered as virtual mIF channels. It is the first model in our missing data layer for biology.

Spatial proteomics from a slide you already have.

Each model output is a virtual multiplex immunofluorescence channel predicted at the resolution of the underlying image. Pan-cancer and pan-tissue.

No extra tissue

The prediction is computational. Precious archival blocks stay intact and go straight back on the shelf.

Whole cohorts

Runs across an entire archive, not a handful of chosen sections, so retrospective studies become viable again.

Pan-cancer

Trained across a broad span of tumour and tissue types rather than a single indication and a fixed marker panel.

Validated at every scale.

Lattice was developed on thousands of tissue regions and millions of image patches, drawn overwhelmingly from cancer tissue and spanning more than a hundred protein markers. Pan-cancer and pan-tissue by construction, rather than tuned to one indication and a fixed panel.

Pixel

Predicted intensity against the real stain, pixel for pixel, on tissue the model never saw during training.

Cell

Cells segmented and typed from the prediction, then matched against the same cells typed from real multiplex.

Region

Marker composition and tissue organisation across a whole slide or tissue core.

Population

Predicted phenotypes carried across entire cohorts into stratification and survival analysis, where the readout is a population-level outcome.
